Appendix G Source inventory and refresh conditions

intro: Use this bank as a menu, not a requirement to review every question on every film. Each entry keeps its stable ID, question, failure hypothesis, practical check/fix, severity and modality/stage filters. The evidence contract in the main guide applies to every entry. Tags are candidate filters; they cannot make an irrelevant question applicable or turn missing evidence into a pass. Detailed machine-readable records remain in the preserved source bank.

questions.question: Can the first image communicate the film's central promise?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Opening conceals the viewing purpose.
questions.check_or_fix: Show opening without its title to a fresh viewer.

questions.question: Does the chosen visual style make the subject easier to understand?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Style adds decoration without explanatory value.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare one beat in the proposed and simpler styles.

questions.question: Is the visual metaphor consistent with the actual mechanism?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Metaphor teaches a false relationship.
questions.check_or_fix: Map each metaphor element to its intended meaning.

questions.question: Would removing the hero character improve the explanation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Host competes with the information.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a host-free version of one dense beat.

questions.question: Does every recurring graphic have a stable meaning?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Decorative reuse changes semantic meaning.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit recurring symbols against a single legend.

questions.question: Is the design distinctive without depending on a borrowed character?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Identity relies on recognizable protected features.
questions.check_or_fix: Replace signature borrowed features with original design logic.

questions.question: Does the visual grammar permit the required emotional range?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Chosen abstraction cannot express the turning point.
questions.check_or_fix: Thumbnail both the quietest and strongest reaction.

questions.question: Is complexity concentrated where the viewer needs information?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Detail budget is spent on irrelevant scenery.
questions.check_or_fix: Rank scene elements by narrative necessity.

questions.question: Can the premise survive without explanatory labels everywhere?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Labels compensate for unreadable action.
questions.check_or_fix: Review a label-free storyboard before refining captions.

questions.question: Does the world establish which impossible actions are allowed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fictional rules change only to resolve the plot.
questions.check_or_fix: List impossible events and seed their rules early.

questions.question: Are style shifts motivated by story or information changes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unmotivated shifts break the film's identity.
questions.check_or_fix: Attach a purpose to each style boundary.

questions.question: Does the palette distinguish functions before decorating them?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Aesthetic palette erases important categories.
questions.check_or_fix: Assign functional roles before choosing accent colors.

questions.question: Can the design scale to the most crowded required scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hero design collapses when multiplied.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the largest crowd at delivery resolution.

questions.question: Is the hero recognizable through its most extreme pose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Design identity depends on one front-facing portrait.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare key poses as small unlabeled thumbnails.

questions.question: Does the setting provide useful action opportunities?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Scenery cannot support the scripted interactions.
questions.check_or_fix: Mark every prop and surface the action uses.

questions.question: Are ornamental motifs misleading viewers about causal importance?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Decorations resemble clues or controls.
questions.check_or_fix: Remove ornaments near the causal focus and compare.

questions.question: Is the intended genre legible before the first reversal?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Comic styling makes serious claims seem unserious.
questions.check_or_fix: Check opening tone against the story's consequence.

questions.question: Does the visual system accommodate uncertainty honestly?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Polished certainty masks incomplete evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Design a clear visual treatment for qualified claims.

questions.question: Are scale exaggerations explicitly separated from measurements?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Expressive proportions are read as quantitative truth.
questions.check_or_fix: Label illustrative scale where comparisons depend on size.

questions.question: Does the design avoid stereotypes as character shorthand?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Identity traits replace individual characterization.
questions.check_or_fix: Give roles distinctive goals and behavior instead.

questions.question: Would an unfamiliar viewer understand the icon vocabulary?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Icons require unstated cultural knowledge.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask viewers to name icons without a legend.

questions.question: Is visual richness earned by meaningful variation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Many objects repeat the same information.
questions.check_or_fix: Remove repeated detail that adds neither rhythm nor meaning.

questions.question: Does the film's aesthetic match its delivery context?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Subtle design disappears in expected viewing conditions.
questions.check_or_fix: Preview under likely screen size and ambient light.

questions.question: Can the design support a clear ending state?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ending looks indistinguishable from the starting state.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare first and last meaningful frames side by side.

questions.question: Is the central contrast visible without narration?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Key comparison exists only in spoken explanation.
questions.check_or_fix: Make the contrasted states visually distinguishable.

questions.question: Does the mood board contain conflicting material rules?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mixed references produce an incoherent world.
questions.check_or_fix: Choose explicit rules for edges, light and texture.

questions.question: Are designed imperfections intentional and repeatable?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Random defects are mistaken for handmade style.
questions.check_or_fix: Define which imperfections belong and remove others.

questions.question: Does abstraction remove the detail needed to judge success?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Simplification hides the actual result.
questions.check_or_fix: Restore the smallest evidence-bearing feature.

questions.question: Can the design accommodate captions without shrinking the action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Accessibility was excluded from the layout concept.
questions.check_or_fix: Reserve readable caption space in initial thumbnails.

questions.question: Does the film need all its branded framing?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Persistent branding consumes attention and action area.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare a restrained framing treatment at phone size.

questions.question: Is there a coherent hierarchy between world and interface graphics?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Labels and physical objects appear equally tangible.
questions.check_or_fix: Give annotations a consistent separate graphic grammar.

questions.question: What single design change would most strengthen the viewing promise?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Many small polish changes avoid the main weakness.
questions.check_or_fix: Choose one premise-level improvement before surface polish.

questions.question: Where does the eye land before any movement occurs?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Bright decoration steals the first fixation.
questions.check_or_fix: Blur the frame and inspect its dominant mass.

questions.question: Is the subject separated from the frame's visual center when needed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Central symmetry suppresses directional tension.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare asymmetric staging for the active beat.

questions.question: Does the focal point stay clear in grayscale?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Color alone creates the hierarchy.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect a grayscale frame at thumbnail size.

questions.question: Are empty areas supporting anticipation or merely unused?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Dead space weakens the action's scale.
questions.check_or_fix: Reframe while preserving necessary look and travel room.

questions.question: Does the composition reserve room for the next action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Movement immediately crashes into the frame edge.
questions.check_or_fix: Storyboard the full action envelope before cropping.

questions.question: Do dominant diagonals point toward the intended event?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Environmental lines direct attention away from the payoff.
questions.check_or_fix: Trace major lines and adjust their endpoints.

questions.question: Is the hero smaller than a visually irrelevant prop?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Scale hierarchy accidentally promotes scenery.
questions.check_or_fix: Reduce the prop or increase hero screen occupancy.

questions.question: Does the frame contain two competing high-contrast centers?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Viewer attention splits during a single causal beat.
questions.check_or_fix: Subdue one center until its turn to matter.

questions.question: Can the critical gesture be seen without hunting?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The gesture occupies a low-salience corner.
questions.check_or_fix: Reposition or simplify neighboring shapes.

questions.question: Does the horizon cut through a meaningful face or hand?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A strong line fragments the focal silhouette.
questions.check_or_fix: Shift camera height or background geometry.

questions.question: Are masses balanced over time rather than only in stills?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Moving crowds overload one side of the frame.
questions.check_or_fix: Sample composition at action extrema.

questions.question: Does a close-up exclude context needed to interpret contact?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Tight framing makes the interaction ambiguous.
questions.check_or_fix: Include the receiving surface or establishing insert.

questions.question: Are graphic borders stealing more contrast than the action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Frame decoration dominates the content.
questions.check_or_fix: Reduce border weight and compare attention.

questions.question: Is the negative space around the reveal preserved?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Surrounding detail swallows the new information.
questions.check_or_fix: Clear a quiet area before the reveal arrives.

questions.question: Do repeated elements form an unintended arrow or word?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Pattern alignment creates misleading visual cues.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect repetitions at small size and oblique angles.

questions.question: Are important objects clipped by aesthetically convenient crops?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Composition removes evidence-bearing parts.
questions.check_or_fix: Check all essential object bounds against the frame.

questions.question: Is the composition understandable when paused mid-action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Only carefully selected endpoints are readable.
questions.check_or_fix: Review random frames between key poses.

questions.question: Does the camera reveal enough of the destination?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Movement has no legible spatial goal.
questions.check_or_fix: Show or establish the target before arrival.

questions.question: Are paired comparisons granted equivalent visual emphasis?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One side appears important because of framing alone.
questions.check_or_fix: Match scale, contrast and dwell time across panels.

questions.question: Does perspective compression make separate objects look attached?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Projected tangencies imply nonexistent connections.
questions.check_or_fix: Adjust view or spacing to separate outlines.

questions.question: Is the foreground framing device obscuring useful information?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cinematic framing hides the causal action.
questions.check_or_fix: Mask its overlap against required evidence regions.

questions.question: Does a large caption reverse the intended visual hierarchy?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The audience reads while the crucial event passes.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate reading and action beats where possible.

questions.question: Are small supporting characters legible as intentional participants?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Minor roles look like noise.
questions.check_or_fix: Group them into readable masses or give clear actions.

questions.question: Does a wide establishing shot remain useful after geography is known?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Repeated wide shots reduce emotional access.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a closer view for the next consequential beat.

questions.question: Can the final composition hold without accidental edge tension?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ending feels cropped or unstable.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect final hold with all overlays and margins.

questions.question: Are parallel lines almost touching and creating visual vibration?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Narrow gaps shimmer or appear fused.
questions.check_or_fix: Increase separation or commit to overlap.

questions.question: Does the layout create a natural reading order?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Viewer sees the answer before the setup.
questions.check_or_fix: Number or stage information in intended sequence.

questions.question: Are visual weights stable across differently colored costumes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One costume dominates unrelated scenes.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare luminance and occupied area across characters.

questions.question: Does the composition survive the intended alternate crop?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reformatting removes the cause or reaction.
questions.check_or_fix: Preview actual crop windows before delivery.

questions.question: Is the hero's gaze given enough look room?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Gaze terminates against the frame edge.
questions.check_or_fix: Adjust framing to reveal the attended space.

questions.question: Does the composition distinguish environment scale from character scale?
questions.failure_hypothesis: No stable reference makes distances ambiguous.
questions.check_or_fix: Include one consistent scale reference.

questions.question: Would removing one object immediately clarify the frame?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Clutter persists because every asset seems precious.
questions.check_or_fix: Perform a subtractive composition pass.

questions.question: Does the hero's outline merge with the scenery at any key pose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Matching values erase the silhouette.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect key poses over grayscale backgrounds.

questions.question: Are foreground and background equally sharp without a reason?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Every layer demands equal attention.
questions.check_or_fix: Use controlled detail or focus hierarchy.

questions.question: Does background motion compete with the hero's reaction?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ambient activity masks the meaningful gesture.
questions.check_or_fix: Pause or reduce background motion during the reaction.

questions.question: Is a dark costume lost against a dark set region?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Local contrast collapses along the path.
questions.check_or_fix: Track costume-background contrast throughout movement.

questions.question: Do background objects resemble extra limbs on the hero?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Aligned props create anatomical ambiguity.
questions.check_or_fix: Move the prop or change camera angle.

questions.question: Does the hero cross a bright patch just before the payoff?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Background flash hijacks the eye.
questions.check_or_fix: Reduce patch contrast or retime the crossing.

questions.question: Are labels visually mistaken for physical scene objects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Overlay styling implies false spatial membership.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a consistent annotation treatment.

questions.question: Can target objects be distinguished from background texture?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Texture contains target-like forms.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect texture without target layers present.

questions.question: Does atmospheric depth weaken an essential distant clue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Depth treatment removes required information.
questions.check_or_fix: Keep evidence contrast above the chosen viewing threshold.

questions.question: Are background crowds individual when the story needs a mass?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Excess individuality produces visual noise.
questions.check_or_fix: Group distant figures while preserving meaningful identities.

questions.question: Do foreground silhouettes block facial reactions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Framing elements cover expression at the worst moment.
questions.check_or_fix: Plot overlap during the full reaction interval.

questions.question: Does scenery contain a stronger face-like pattern than the hero?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Pareidolia steals attention from intended characters.
questions.check_or_fix: Simplify face-like background clusters.

questions.question: Are foreground edge treatments consistent with the background medium?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cutout edges look pasted onto incompatible art.
questions.check_or_fix: Match appropriate softness, grain and contour logic.

questions.question: Does foreground saturation overwhelm subtle background evidence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Accent color makes the clue easy to miss.
questions.check_or_fix: Rebalance saturation around the evidence beat.

questions.question: Is the background too blank to establish contact and scale?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Minimalism removes grounding cues.
questions.check_or_fix: Add restrained ground plane and reference details.

questions.question: Does a background line continue through the hero as a tangent?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Apparent line continuity flattens the layer separation.
questions.check_or_fix: Break or relocate the line behind the subject.

questions.question: Is the hero distinguishable during backlighting?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Silhouette merges into an uncontrolled dark mass.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve contour or adjust background luminance.

questions.question: Are distant outlines heavier than foreground outlines?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Line weight reverses the depth hierarchy.
questions.check_or_fix: Normalize contour weight by intended depth logic.

questions.question: Does background contrast rise during narration-heavy passages?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Scenery competes with reading and listening.
questions.check_or_fix: Reduce nonessential contrast during information delivery.

questions.question: Can a newcomer identify which objects are interactive?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Visual affordances do not distinguish usable props.
questions.check_or_fix: Give important props clear placement or introduction.

questions.question: Does the background change imply a location change unintentionally?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Palette or texture shifts break scene identity.
questions.check_or_fix: Match persistent landmarks across adjacent shots.

questions.question: Are foreground particles obscuring the decisive contact frame?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Effects conceal whether the action succeeded.
questions.check_or_fix: Delay or thin particles at the contact moment.

questions.question: Does a moving background make a stationary subject seem to drift?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Relative motion creates unintended self-motion.
questions.check_or_fix: Add stable grounding cues or change motion balance.

questions.question: Do shadows merge foreground and background into one blob?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Shadow design removes object separation.
questions.check_or_fix: Adjust shadow softness, offset or intensity.

questions.question: Does a light outline become a distracting halo?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Separation aid looks like a compositing defect.
questions.check_or_fix: Test subtler contour and local-background adjustments.

questions.question: Are foreground and background using incompatible perspective cues?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The subject appears pasted into another world.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare horizon, vanishing directions and scale cues.

questions.question: Can background story details be discovered without stealing the main beat?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Secondary storytelling competes with primary causality.
questions.check_or_fix: Place discoveries in quieter intervals.

questions.question: Does color grading erase previously good layer separation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Final treatment compresses local contrast.
questions.check_or_fix: Repeat separation checks on the encoded graded output.

questions.question: Are reflected subjects confused with additional real subjects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reflections lack a clear surface context.
questions.check_or_fix: Make the reflective boundary and relationship legible.

questions.question: Does foreground blur hide information the viewer must use?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Depth-of-field prioritizes atmosphere over evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Keep task-relevant objects in an inspectable focus range.

questions.question: Can the scene remain readable on a dim phone display?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Low-end viewing conditions collapse contrast.
questions.check_or_fix: Preview at modest brightness and intended size.

questions.question: Are guide lines strong enough to remain visible in the overview?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Navigation cues disappear when the camera pulls back.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the wide encoded frame at phone size and adjust guide contrast if needed.

questions.question: Does every overlap agree with the intended front-to-back order?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Layer order contradicts scene geometry.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect crossings against a depth-order map.

questions.question: Does an occluded object return with the same identity?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reappearance silently substitutes the object.
questions.check_or_fix: Track stable object IDs through occlusion.

questions.question: Are disoccluded areas actually painted or modeled?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Camera movement exposes empty holes.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect maximum parallax and edge reveals.

questions.question: Does a hand disappear behind the prop it should hold in front?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Incorrect depth ordering breaks the grasp.
questions.check_or_fix: Review hand-prop masks at contact extrema.

questions.question: Are transparent surfaces ordered correctly with opaque objects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Transparency sorting creates impossible overlaps.
questions.check_or_fix: Test each intersecting layer from the final camera.

questions.question: Does the hero pass through a foreground object without response?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Occlusion hides a geometric collision.
questions.check_or_fix: Check trajectories against collision silhouettes.

questions.question: Do objects change apparent depth without crossing a boundary?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sort order pops during movement.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect depth swaps one frame at a time.

questions.question: Can the viewer infer which route lies above another?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Crossing paths have ambiguous elevation.
questions.check_or_fix: Add bridge, shadow or cutaway cues.

questions.question: Is a distant object larger without an established scale reason?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Projection cues imply impossible depth.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare world scale and camera projection.

questions.question: Does parallax direction agree with camera travel?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Layers move as if depth were inverted.
questions.check_or_fix: Plot layer displacement against declared depth.

questions.question: Are contact shadows behind the correct object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Shadow stacking contradicts grounding.
questions.check_or_fix: Review shadow masks independently from color layers.

questions.question: Does a mask hide more than the physical occluder should?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Loose masks remove visible limbs or props.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare matte contour to the actual boundary.

questions.question: Are soft alpha edges revealing the hidden layer unnaturally?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Premultiplication or feathering creates ghost edges.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect compositing over contrasting backgrounds.

questions.question: Does depth-of-field change imply a different focal plane than intended?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Focus favors the wrong spatial relationship.
questions.check_or_fix: Mark focus targets against shot purpose.

questions.question: Can partly occluded characters still be counted fairly?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Occlusion leaves ambiguous identity fragments.
questions.check_or_fix: Review visible identifying features for each counted entity.

questions.question: Does the foreground reveal happen before the viewer needs it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Late disocclusion withholds causal information.
questions.check_or_fix: Move the reveal earlier or add an establishing cue.

questions.question: Are far objects clipped by a near-plane artifact?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Camera settings remove legitimate scene geometry.
questions.check_or_fix: Check clipping planes at closest camera positions.

questions.question: Does a cutaway show interior parts in their real relative positions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Illustrative separation masquerades as spatial truth.
questions.check_or_fix: Label exploded offsets or restore spatial registration.

questions.question: Are stacked paper planes thick enough to match their shadows?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Shadow depth exceeds the depicted material thickness.
questions.check_or_fix: Align layer spacing and shadow treatment.

questions.question: Does a rotating flat asset expose its lack of volume?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Billboard rotation reveals an unintended paper edge.
questions.check_or_fix: Limit rotation or provide appropriate alternate geometry.

questions.question: Are reflections occluded consistently with the reflecting surface?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reflection content ignores scene boundaries.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare reflection mask with surface visibility.

questions.question: Does a moving camera reveal duplicate copies of one object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Patch layers overlap as two distinct objects.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect seams during the entire camera move.

questions.question: Is an object hidden for so long that its return feels unmotivated?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Occlusion becomes an unexplained teleport.
questions.check_or_fix: Retain an audible or visual continuity cue.

questions.question: Do atmospheric layers correctly exclude nearer objects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fog paints over the wrong depth range.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect depth masks against scene distances.

questions.question: Can depth be understood without relying solely on size?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Identical-size assets flatten the scene.
questions.check_or_fix: Use overlap, ground contact and perspective cues together.

questions.question: Are depth transitions smooth enough for the intended medium?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Layer snapping produces unintended spatial jumps.
questions.check_or_fix: Use controlled sorting boundaries or continuous geometry.

questions.question: Does the background show through a supposedly solid object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Alpha or topology holes contradict solidity.
questions.check_or_fix: Check object opacity and silhouette interiors.

questions.question: Are multiple viewpoints showing the same occluded state?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Views disagree about object visibility and position.
questions.check_or_fix: Synchronize cameras to one scene-time sample.

questions.question: Does a label's leader line terminate on the visible object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Occluded endpoints attach to the wrong surface.
questions.check_or_fix: Reproject anchors and inspect final pixels.

questions.question: Is the occlusion itself doing useful storytelling?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Obscuration creates difficulty without payoff.
questions.check_or_fix: Remove arbitrary blockers from the causal beat.

questions.question: Does the depth treatment remain coherent during a zoom?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Screen-space layers scale as incompatible distances.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare scaling rates across near and far planes.

questions.question: Can a viewer tell an intentional hidden clue from missing artwork?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unexplained gaps resemble rendering errors.
questions.check_or_fix: Design a readable occluder and fair reveal.

questions.question: Is the character's immediate goal visible in the staging?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Movement has no readable target.
questions.check_or_fix: Place goal and actor in a clear spatial relationship.

questions.question: Does the actor face the important event when it occurs?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Blocking hides attention and response.
questions.check_or_fix: Align gaze and torso with the attended event.

questions.question: Are cause and consequence visible in the same beat?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Staging separates the action from its result.
questions.check_or_fix: Reframe or add a motivated reaction cut.

questions.question: Does a supporting character accidentally steal the scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Secondary action is larger or earlier than the main action.
questions.check_or_fix: Reduce its motion during the decisive beat.

questions.question: Can characters reach their props without implausible stretching?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Prop placement exceeds the rig's natural reach.
questions.check_or_fix: Check reach envelopes before animation.

questions.question: Is a crucial exchange hidden behind another body?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Blocking conceals possession transfer.
questions.check_or_fix: Open a clean sightline to the handoff.

questions.question: Does each character have a distinct action rather than generic motion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Busy movement substitutes for intention.
questions.check_or_fix: Assign one playable objective per beat.

questions.question: Are entrances timed to establish identity before interaction?
questions.failure_hypothesis: New actors arrive and act before recognition.
questions.check_or_fix: Allow an orienting pose or entrance cue.

questions.question: Does the exit direction preserve the established geography?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A character leaves toward an impossible destination.
questions.check_or_fix: Track screen and world directions together.

questions.question: Is the obstacle positioned where it can genuinely impede the goal?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Conflict is asserted without spatial support.
questions.check_or_fix: Show the blocked route and available alternatives.

questions.question: Do characters queue in a visually traceable order?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Crowd staging implies multiple conflicting lines.
questions.check_or_fix: Trace the queue path through turns and overlaps.

questions.question: Is a reaction staged where viewers are already looking?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Important response occurs outside the attention region.
questions.check_or_fix: Move the reaction or guide attention before it.

questions.question: Does the hero turn away during the most expressive pose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Blocking hides the emotional information.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a readable three-quarter orientation.

questions.question: Are characters standing too close to read as separate agents?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Bodies merge into an ambiguous group.
questions.check_or_fix: Create meaningful spacing or stagger depth.

questions.question: Does the staging support the intended power relationship?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Height and distance contradict the dramatic roles.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare status cues with the scene's intention.

questions.question: Can the viewer see the object before it becomes important?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A prop appears only at the solution.
questions.check_or_fix: Plant the prop naturally in an earlier composition.

questions.question: Does the solution require an unestablished route or opening?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Blocking invents space at the climax.
questions.check_or_fix: Establish usable pathways before the payoff.

questions.question: Are pauses placed where bodies can actually balance?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A held pose would topple without support.
questions.check_or_fix: Shift weight or add a justified contact point.

questions.question: Does simultaneous action overload the viewer's attention?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Several causal events compete within one interval.
questions.check_or_fix: Sequence actions or establish a deliberate hierarchy.

questions.question: Are paired characters differentiated by behavior and position?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Symmetric blocking makes identities interchangeable.
questions.check_or_fix: Give each a distinct stance and objective.

questions.question: Does the actor's path cross readable text at the wrong time?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Action occludes information during its reading interval.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate path and text regions or retime them.

questions.question: Are the most important hands visible from the chosen angle?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Torso or costume hides the acting instrument.
questions.check_or_fix: Adjust elbows, prop position or camera.

questions.check_or_fix: Audit secondary contributions of disabled elements.

questions.question: Are nested transforms applied exactly once?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Parent and child scaling double the movement.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a known anchor through the transform chain.

questions.question: Does a screen-space effect remain confined to its intended region?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Glow, blur or displacement leaks into captions.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect effect masks around protected areas.

questions.question: Are depth mattes temporally aligned with color frames?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One-frame offset creates edge tearing.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare frame indices across render passes.

questions.question: Does a color key remove similarly colored subject details?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Keying erases clothing or props.
questions.check_or_fix: Review retained subject pixels against the key range.

questions.question: Are transparent assets stored with enough edge color information?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Resampling reveals contaminated matte colors.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect edge pixels before and after scaling.

questions.question: Does compositing preserve the intended color space?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Linear and display-referred operations are mixed.
questions.check_or_fix: Document conversions around blends and grading.

questions.question: Are repeated elements independently addressable when the story requires it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One baked layer prevents necessary repairs.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate only the elements needing distinct control.

questions.question: Does a foreground wipe reveal the correct underlying shot at every frame?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Transition matte exposes stale or wrong content.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the wipe boundary across its full duration.

questions.question: Are adjustment layers scoped to the correct shot range?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Grade or blur leaks into neighboring scenes.
questions.check_or_fix: Check in/out boundaries and nested compositions.

questions.question: Does a drop shadow imply inappropriate physical depth for text?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Labels look like floating solid objects.
questions.check_or_fix: Use annotation-specific shadow restraint.

questions.question: Are compound masks preserving holes and internal contours?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fill rules close intended openings.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect even-odd and winding behavior on key shapes.

questions.question: Does resampling order unnecessarily soften the subject?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Repeated scale operations degrade edges.
questions.check_or_fix: Composite at an appropriate master scale once.

questions.question: Are layer names and IDs sufficient to locate the visible defect?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Opaque naming makes targeted repair expensive.
questions.check_or_fix: Map visible elements to stable source identifiers.

questions.question: Does the composite include unintended guide or debug layers?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Production scaffolding appears in the final movie.
questions.check_or_fix: Scan final frames for guides, handles and diagnostics.

questions.question: Are reflections derived from the same current scene state?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reflection layer contains outdated poses.
questions.check_or_fix: Link reflection generation to the shared state.

questions.question: Does an effect respect occlusion by nearer objects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Glow or particles appear through solid foregrounds.
questions.check_or_fix: Apply appropriate depth-aware masks.

questions.question: Are per-layer frame rates reconciled explicitly?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Different rates create stutter or duplicated motion.
questions.check_or_fix: Normalize timing while preserving source intent.

questions.question: Does a compositing shortcut remain valid at the largest planned camera move?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Patch works only in the preview framing.
questions.check_or_fix: Stress-test the actual camera envelope.

questions.question: Would separating one problematic layer enable a much cleaner fix?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Baked composite prevents precise correction.
questions.check_or_fix: Isolate the smallest repairable element.

questions.question: Does the important object keep the same owner across the cut?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Possession changes without an exchange.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare ownership immediately before and after edits.

questions.question: Are character screen directions consistent through continuous travel?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cut reverses the apparent route.
questions.check_or_fix: Track world path and projected direction.

questions.question: Does the costume retain meaningful details between shots?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Character identity changes unintentionally.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare distinctive features across adjacent views.

questions.question: Are persistent props present in the correct locations after reframing?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Set objects vanish or teleport.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a scene-state ledger and frame comparison.

questions.question: Does elapsed story time match visible environmental change?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Lighting or wear changes too quickly.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit chronology against state changes.

questions.question: Are actions matched at the same phase across an edit?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Motion jumps backward or repeats.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare pose and velocity around the cut.

questions.question: Does a consumed or broken object remain changed afterward?
questions.failure_hypothesis: State resets undermine consequence.
questions.check_or_fix: Track irreversible state transitions explicitly.

questions.question: Are crowds preserving entity identity through occlusion and return?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Duplicate or missing actors alter the story.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit persistent IDs rather than visible count alone.

questions.question: Does the timeline preserve the order of cause and effect?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Result appears before its enabling event.
questions.check_or_fix: Check event dependencies against frame times.

questions.question: Are labels describing the current state rather than the previous shot?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Overlay update lags the scene.
questions.check_or_fix: Join label state to the same event clock.

questions.question: Does a map remain geometrically consistent across zooms?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Local views contradict the overview.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare landmarks in shared world coordinates.

questions.question: Are the hero's handedness and held items stable?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mirrored shots swap meaningful hands.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit left-right semantics at each camera change.

questions.question: Does a door or obstacle remain open after being moved?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Environment resets without narrative explanation.
questions.check_or_fix: Retain state across scene boundaries.

questions.question: Are marks, damage and dirt consistent with prior events?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Evidence of action disappears.
questions.check_or_fix: Track material changes as persistent states.

questions.question: Does a returning character enter from a plausible location?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reentry contradicts the established exit.
questions.check_or_fix: Map offscreen travel and available time.

questions.question: Are numerical counters updated at the event they claim to count?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Display increments early or twice.
questions.check_or_fix: Bind counters to unique event IDs.

questions.question: Does a clock distinguish story time from playback time clearly?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Timer implies an inaccurate duration.
questions.check_or_fix: Document timer semantics and check displayed values.

questions.question: Are alternative viewpoints synchronized to the same object state?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Comparison panels show incompatible moments.
questions.check_or_fix: Use one authoritative state sample per frame.

questions.question: Does a repeated flashback look distinct from current action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Temporal structure is ambiguous.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a consistent bounded flashback cue.

questions.question: Are object scale changes motivated by camera or story events?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Props resize between shots unnoticed by the script.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare world dimensions and projection separately.

questions.question: Does a loop return to a compatible starting state?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ending creates a discontinuity on replay.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect seam pose, ownership and environment.

questions.question: Are hidden objects still accounted for in the state model?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Occlusion is mistaken for deletion.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate visibility from existence.

questions.question: Does the final count refer to entities rather than repeated appearances?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reentry inflates the claimed population.
questions.check_or_fix: Count unique IDs under the declared rule.

questions.question: Are scene resets labeled when demonstrating alternatives?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Viewer interprets a comparison as continuous action.
questions.check_or_fix: Mark resets or maintain a clear split-screen structure.

questions.question: Does the narrative preserve information characters have learned?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Actor forgets the solution to prolong the plot.
questions.check_or_fix: Track knowledge state alongside physical state.

questions.question: Are shadows and reflections consistent with object existence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Removed objects leave visual evidence behind.
questions.check_or_fix: Check secondary passes after state changes.

questions.question: Does the final artifact correspond to the cited source revision?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Review evidence describes an older movie.
questions.check_or_fix: Match hashes and version identifiers before approval.

questions.question: Are title, captions and narration using the same names and numbers?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Parallel text sources drift apart.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare against one approved script ledger.

questions.question: Does a repaired shot retain compatibility with neighboring shots?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Local fix introduces a new continuity break.
questions.check_or_fix: Review both boundaries after replacement.

questions.question: Are transition overlaps creating a brief duplicate of a unique object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Crossfade looks like two simultaneous copies.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect mixed frames at peak overlap.

questions.question: Does the ending retain the unresolved constraint needed for the joke?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Final state accidentally removes the comic problem.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare payoff requirements with the actual tableau.

questions.question: Would a small continuity cue prevent a major viewer misreading?
questions.failure_hypothesis: State change is correct but visually unannounced.
questions.check_or_fix: Add one clear possession, location or time cue.

questions.question: Does the opening hold let a first-time viewer locate the subject before the first important action begins?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Action starts before visual orientation completes.
questions.check_or_fix: Test an unbriefed first viewing and move the action after orientation.

questions.question: Is the last readable frame of the problem held long enough to inspect every required condition?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The question disappears before its constraints can be read.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure actual reading completion and extend the fully resolved problem frame.

questions.question: Does the pause before a character's choice occur after the audience has seen what each option costs?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Suspense precedes information needed to care about the choice.
questions.check_or_fix: Move the pause after the cost-establishing shots.

questions.question: Does a reveal remain visible long enough for viewers to connect it back to the earlier clue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The edit leaves before recognition catches up.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare immediate and slightly longer reveal holds with new viewers.

questions.question: Are repeated demonstration cycles still adding information after the audience understands the pattern?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Identical cycles consume runtime without advancing understanding.
questions.check_or_fix: Remove one repetition and test whether the inference still holds.

questions.question: Does the montage accelerate before any individual example becomes too brief to identify?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Escalating shot speed erases the examples it is meant to summarize.
questions.check_or_fix: Find the shortest reliably identified shot and retime the montage around it.

questions.question: Can viewers finish looking from a label to the object it names before the label changes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Label turnover is faster than the required eye movement.
questions.check_or_fix: Hold each label across a complete label-to-object inspection.

questions.question: Does a quiet reaction beat expose a new emotion rather than merely freezing the same pose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A nominal pause provides no evolving performance to watch.
questions.check_or_fix: Add a motivated reaction change or shorten the hold.

questions.question: Is the explanation allowed a processing pause after its hardest inference rather than only between sentences?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Evenly spaced pauses ignore where cognitive effort peaks.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask viewers to explain each inference and insert space at the bottleneck.

questions.question: Does the countdown begin only when the complete puzzle is available for inspection?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Intro animation silently consumes the promised solving time.
questions.check_or_fix: Start the timer at the first fully inspectable puzzle frame.

questions.question: Is the apparent urgency appropriate to the task, especially when correct action requires careful checking?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fast cutting rewards hurried decisions in a deliberate procedure.
questions.check_or_fix: Repace the sequence around the actual checking steps.

questions.question: Does slowing a shot preserve readable movement rather than expose an unintentional freeze or cadence break?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Excessive retiming makes the intended continuous action look stalled.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect frame progression and choose an intentional slow-motion treatment.

questions.question: Can the audience predict the destination before a long camera move finishes, making its remaining travel expendable?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Camera transit continues after its information has been delivered.
questions.check_or_fix: Trim redundant travel while retaining spatial orientation.

questions.question: Does each new section begin before the previous conclusion has had time to register?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Back-to-back chapter changes overwrite the preceding takeaway.
questions.check_or_fix: Add a short resolved beat or simplify the next opening.

questions.question: Does the final message survive a platform loop without being interrupted by the opening?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Loop restart truncates the audience's last reading or emotional beat.
questions.check_or_fix: Watch repeated playback and extend or restructure the endpoint.

questions.question: Is the longest static hold placed where viewers have something meaningful to examine?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Runtime is allocated to an already exhausted image.
questions.check_or_fix: Reassign hold time to a denser evidence or reaction shot.

questions.question: When two facts arrive together, is there enough time to compare them rather than merely notice both?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Side-by-side evidence is displayed for recognition time, not comparison time.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the stated comparison question and extend the shared interval.

questions.question: Does a joke leave space for the audience's laugh without hiding the next essential line?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The next information beat lands during the likely reaction.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with viewers and delay or simplify the following line.

questions.question: Is the pacing difference between anticipation, impact, and recovery perceptible at ordinary playback speed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Uniform timing flattens the action into a mechanical sequence.
questions.check_or_fix: Contrast the three phases in the animatic and retime selectively.

questions.question: Does a duration target force deletion of the only shot that explains a causal step?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Runtime compliance is achieved by removing necessary reasoning.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve the causal shot and cut lower-value repetition instead.

questions.question: Do viewers mistake an intentional contemplative hold for a stalled player?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The held image provides no cue that the film is still progressing.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the hold cold and add subtle meaningful progression if needed.

questions.question: Does narration continue asking viewers to absorb facts while the image demands intensive visual search?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reading, listening, and searching compete for the same interval.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate the search window from new spoken instruction.

questions.question: Are crossfades stealing useful exposure from shots already near the minimum readable duration?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Most of a short shot is spent in a blended, ambiguous state.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure fully settled exposure and shorten dissolves or extend shots.

questions.question: Does a build-up repeat the same emotional intensity until the climax has nowhere to go?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Constant maximum energy removes escalation and contrast.
questions.check_or_fix: Chart perceived intensity and create a lower-energy baseline.

questions.question: Is the live demonstration's waiting time honestly represented when it is compressed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A brisk cut makes a slow real-world step look instantaneous.
questions.check_or_fix: Mark elapsed time or retain a representative waiting cue.

questions.question: Does the video give the viewer a moment to answer a direct question before answering it itself?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A rhetorical prompt masquerades as a genuine participation opportunity.
questions.check_or_fix: Time an unbriefed response and delay the answer accordingly.

questions.question: Does the hold on an error last so long that viewers encode it as the recommended behavior?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Incorrect content receives more emphasis than its correction.
questions.check_or_fix: Label the error immediately and give the correction a clear settled beat.

questions.question: Is a fast action replayed only after viewers understand why they are watching it again?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Repetition arrives without a new observation goal.
questions.check_or_fix: Introduce the detail to watch before the replay.

questions.question: Can a viewer who blinks during the decisive event recover its meaning from the surrounding shots?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Essential information exists in a single unreinforced instant.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve consequence or add a motivated replay without spoiling surprise.

questions.question: Does the closing credit or logo hold disproportionately dilute a very short film's useful runtime?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Branding consumes the resolution interval and weakens the ending.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare completion and recall with a shorter credit treatment.

questions.question: Are beat lengths varied because of content, rather than because every scene was generated from one duration template?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Template timing forces different cognitive tasks into identical slots.
questions.check_or_fix: Assign duration from each shot's action and reading demand.

questions.question: Does the final export preserve the approved pause lengths after frame-rate conversion or speed conforming?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A technical conform changes the timing decisions already reviewed.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare landmark timestamps between approved reference and delivered encode.

questions.question: What visible event establishes what the protagonist wants before the first obstacle appears?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The plot moves before a goal gives its events meaning.
questions.check_or_fix: Add or clarify a goal-defining action in the opening.

questions.question: Is the obstacle caused by the established situation, or does an unexplained intervention manufacture it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Arbitrary trouble replaces causal storytelling.
questions.check_or_fix: Connect the obstacle to a shown condition or earlier choice.

questions.question: Does the eventual solution use a capability or resource the audience had a fair chance to notice?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An unseeded resource resolves the conflict without earned setup.
questions.check_or_fix: Seed the resource naturally before its decisive use.

questions.question: Can viewers tell what failure would cost the character without being told in a long caption?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Stakes remain abstract and do not support the action.
questions.check_or_fix: Show one concrete consequence of failure before escalation.

questions.question: Does the character's final choice differ meaningfully from the choice they would have made at the start?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Surface action conceals an unchanged dramatic state.
questions.check_or_fix: Define the changed belief or keep the piece explicitly observational.

questions.question: Is the payoff answering the specific expectation created by the opening image or line?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The film promises one question and resolves another.
questions.check_or_fix: Write the promise and payoff side by side and reconcile them.

questions.question: Does an early background detail actually matter later, or merely imitate the look of foreshadowing?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Decorative setup attracts attention without narrative return.
questions.check_or_fix: Pay off, downweight, or remove the conspicuous detail.

questions.question: Can viewers distinguish a deliberate misdirection from information the film simply withheld unfairly?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Surprise depends on hiding facts the chosen viewpoint should reveal.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit viewpoint access and plant an honest alternative interpretation.

questions.question: Does the protagonist cause the resolution through an understandable action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Coincidence completes the story while the protagonist watches.
questions.check_or_fix: Link the resolution to a choice, effort, or purposeful nonaction.

questions.question: Is the helper's intervention motivated before it becomes essential?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A convenient helper enters solely to repair the plot.
questions.check_or_fix: Establish the helper's motive or prior relationship.

questions.question: Do repeated failed attempts change the character's understanding or the audience's expectation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Escalation is padded with interchangeable failures.
questions.check_or_fix: Give each attempt a distinct lesson, cost, or strategy change.

questions.question: Does the middle contain a meaningful change in circumstances rather than a longer version of the opening problem?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The story stalls between premise and ending.
questions.check_or_fix: Introduce a consequence that forces a different approach.

questions.question: Is a comic reversal grounded in a recognizable expectation that the audience actually forms?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The punchline overturns an assumption viewers never made.
questions.check_or_fix: Test predictions immediately before the reversal and adjust setup.

questions.question: Can the central relationship be inferred from behavior instead of unexplained symbolic labels?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Relationship stakes depend on exposition the film never supplies.
questions.check_or_fix: Add an interaction that demonstrates the relevant bond or tension.

questions.question: Does a flashback explain the present action without introducing a second unresolved story?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Backstory competes with the current goal and creates stray promises.
questions.check_or_fix: Limit the flashback to the fact needed for the present decision.

questions.question: Is the audience supposed to know more than the character, and is that knowledge difference consistently maintained?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Inconsistent dramatic irony makes reactions look irrational.
questions.check_or_fix: Track audience and character knowledge at every reveal.

questions.question: Does the ending show the consequence of the solution, rather than cutting immediately after the successful action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Resolution is asserted without a visible changed state.
questions.check_or_fix: Add a concise consequence or reaction that confirms the result.

questions.question: Is an ambiguous ending intentionally bounded to a small set of interpretations?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Missing information is mistaken for purposeful ambiguity.
questions.check_or_fix: State the intended open question and test plausible readings.

questions.question: Does an emotional reversal have a visible trigger that belongs to this character?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Music or narration substitutes for motivated emotional change.
questions.check_or_fix: Show the triggering observation or decision in performance.

questions.question: Are objects important to the payoff introduced with enough identity to be recognized later?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The audience sees a prop but cannot connect its later appearance.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve a distinctive feature and stage its first appearance clearly.

questions.question: Does the resolution honor the world's established rules about ability, scale, or consequence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The film changes its own rules to obtain a convenient ending.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the payoff against a short explicit world-rule sheet.

questions.question: Does a supposed sacrifice actually remove something the film has shown to matter?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The story asks for emotion without demonstrating a real cost.
questions.check_or_fix: Establish the value beforehand and show the loss afterward.

questions.question: Can a short explanatory story be summarized as a causal chain rather than a list of related facts?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Topic coherence is mistaken for an explanatory argument.
questions.check_or_fix: Connect each fact to the mechanism the next beat develops.

questions.question: Does the opening question remain answerable from the evidence actually shown?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The story drifts into a broader claim than its demonstration supports.
questions.check_or_fix: Narrow the question or supply the missing evidence.

questions.question: Is the demonstration's result revealed only after the viewer has seen the relevant starting conditions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Outcome-first editing makes a causal lesson impossible to evaluate.
questions.check_or_fix: Show the necessary baseline before interpreting the result.

questions.question: Does a moral or takeaway emerge from the shown consequences rather than contradicting them?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The closing lesson is appended despite contrary story evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Rewrite the takeaway to match the events or revise those events.

questions.question: Do two parallel storylines intersect for a reason the audience can explain?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Alternation suggests a relationship that never becomes meaningful.
questions.check_or_fix: Establish the shared cause, contrast, or eventual interaction.

questions.question: Is a character's misunderstanding plausible from what they actually saw and heard?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The plot relies on ignorance despite available information.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit the character's sensory access and adjust the mistaken inference.

questions.question: Does a callback change the meaning of the original beat rather than merely repeat it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Familiarity is used as a substitute for a payoff.
questions.check_or_fix: Give the repeated action a new consequence or interpretation.

questions.question: Is a cliffhanger appropriate to the promised viewing experience, or does it withhold the only useful answer?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An incomplete ending breaks the short film's central promise.
questions.check_or_fix: Resolve the promised unit before opening a new question.

questions.question: If the final caption were removed, would the key emotional or causal resolution still be visible?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Explanatory text conceals an unstaged ending.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a caption-free cut and strengthen the decisive visual action.

questions.question: Could the premise survive a change of palette and rendering style because its dramatic mechanism is specific?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cosmetic variation is being counted as a genuinely new story.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare goals, obstacles, choices, and outcomes across related pieces.

questions.question: Does the cut preserve the moving subject's screen direction when viewers need to track a continuous journey?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A direction reversal implies a turn that never happened.
questions.check_or_fix: Insert an orienting shot or choose directionally consistent coverage.

questions.question: Is a jump across the action axis motivated by a visible crossing or a clear new orientation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unsignaled axis crossing reverses spatial relationships.
questions.check_or_fix: Establish the new axis before relying on left-right meaning.

questions.question: Does an action match join the same physical phase rather than replaying or skipping the decisive movement?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The cut duplicates or omits part of one action.
questions.check_or_fix: Align contact and limb landmarks across both takes.

questions.question: Does the viewer's gaze land near the next shot's important subject after the cut?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A large unprepared attention jump hides the next event.
questions.check_or_fix: Reframe, delay the event, or guide gaze before cutting.

questions.question: Is a dissolve briefly creating a false composite count, relationship, or impossible object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Overlapping shots produce misleading intermediate evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect transition frames and use a clean cut for exact evidence.

questions.question: Does a wipe reveal scene information in a deliberate order rather than cover the clue at the crucial moment?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Transition geometry dictates an unintended information sequence.
questions.check_or_fix: Align the wipe path with the intended reveal order.

questions.question: Are match cuts based on meaningful shared form or action, rather than a resemblance too weak to read?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The conceptual connection depends on an unnoticed visual match.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the cut without explanation and strengthen the common anchor.

questions.question: Does a temporal jump make elapsed time legible without being mistaken for continuous action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A cut compresses time while preserving misleading continuity cues.
questions.check_or_fix: Add a changed-state cue or concise elapsed-time marker.

questions.question: Can viewers identify a location change before interpreting the next action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A new setting inherits the previous scene's spatial assumptions.
questions.check_or_fix: Establish one distinctive spatial cue before the action.

questions.question: Does an inserted reaction shot belong to the event and moment viewers are likely to attribute to it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Editorial juxtaposition fabricates a response or relationship.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify take context and use an honestly corresponding reaction.

questions.question: Does a cutaway conceal the only evidence that an operation actually succeeded?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Editing replaces observable completion with an implied result.
questions.check_or_fix: Retain the critical completion interval or label the discontinuity.

questions.question: Are transition effects consistent with the distinction between memory, imagination, and present action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The same visual grammar marks incompatible narrative states.
questions.check_or_fix: Assign a readable transition rule to each state.

questions.question: Does the return from an insert reestablish the subject's position after the audience has lost spatial context?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A close detail interrupts tracking without a way back.
questions.check_or_fix: Return to a matching anchor or include an orienting view.

questions.question: Is a hidden cut exposed by a mismatch in texture, object position, or movement speed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A supposedly seamless join contains a local discontinuity.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare both sides frame by frame and repair or make the cut explicit.

questions.question: Does a crossfade between faces or text create a distracting hybrid expression or unreadable word?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Blended semantic features attract attention to the transition itself.
questions.check_or_fix: Shorten the overlap or choose a nonblending transition.

questions.question: Is the shot sequence using eyelines that point toward the intended person or object?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mismatched look direction connects the wrong spatial targets.
questions.check_or_fix: Plot eyelines and replace or reposition inconsistent coverage.

questions.question: Does the edit accidentally imply that two simultaneous processes happened one after another?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sequential presentation changes the timing relationship.
questions.check_or_fix: Add overlap, split-screen, or an explicit simultaneity cue.

questions.question: Do split-screen panels remain synchronized at meaningful events after separate retiming?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Independent edits fabricate a comparative advantage or delay.
questions.check_or_fix: Lock shared landmarks to one time reference.

questions.question: Is an L-cut carrying dialogue into a shot where viewers might attribute it to the wrong speaker?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Continued speech is reassigned by the new image.
questions.check_or_fix: Clarify speaker identity or change the cut point.

questions.question: Does a J-cut reveal a place, person, or answer earlier than the visual story intends?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Incoming sound spoils a planned visual reveal.
questions.check_or_fix: Check the reveal once without prior knowledge and move the audio entrance.

questions.question: Do alternating close-ups preserve the number and identity of objects in the shared scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Coverage changes make one object look like several or vice versa.
questions.check_or_fix: Maintain distinctive identifiers and a confirming wide shot.

questions.question: Does cutting on every musical beat flatten the distinction between important actions and decorative motion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Beat-grid obedience overrides editorial emphasis.
questions.check_or_fix: Reserve selected cuts for meaningful events and let minor beats pass.

questions.question: Does a transition rely on motion blur that removes evidence viewers need to verify continuity?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Visual concealment masks inconsistent scene state.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect clean boundary frames and repair underlying continuity.

questions.question: Are freeze-frame inserts clearly intentional rather than accidental dropped motion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unmarked frozen footage resembles playback failure.
questions.check_or_fix: Add an editorial cue or preserve subtle contextual motion.

questions.question: Does a black-frame punctuation create an unintended apparent end before more essential content follows?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A long black interval triggers abandonment.
questions.check_or_fix: Shorten the gap or keep an unmistakable continuation cue.

questions.question: Is the transition out of a screen recording hiding a click or system response needed to reproduce the task?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Edit compression removes a necessary interaction.
questions.check_or_fix: Keep the command and resulting state together or annotate the omission.

questions.question: Does the edit preserve a physical object's trajectory through an occlusion rather than teleport it to a convenient position?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Occlusion is used to disguise an impossible path.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare pre/post-occlusion position and plausible travel time.

questions.question: Are parallel cuts suggesting causation where only coincidence is supported?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Juxtaposition converts correlation into an apparent causal link.
questions.check_or_fix: Reorder or label the relationship to match the evidence.

questions.question: Does an aspect-ratio change carry meaning or merely distract at a scene boundary?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unexplained framing shifts feel like an export or source mismatch.
questions.check_or_fix: Standardize framing or establish the narrative reason for the shift.

questions.question: Does the final cut remove the last tiny movement required to see an object settle or a gesture finish?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Action is truncated at nominal contact rather than perceptual completion.
questions.check_or_fix: Include recovery and check the endpoint at normal speed.

questions.question: Are alternate takes introducing continuity errors in prop state, costume, or handedness that affect understanding?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The edit joins incompatible world states.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit story-relevant state on both sides of every coverage change.

questions.question: If an elaborate transition is replaced with a straight cut, what comprehension or emotion is actually lost?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Decorative transitions add workload without serving the story.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare a plain-cut version and retain only purposeful complexity.

questions.question: Can the smallest essential label be read at the intended phone viewing size without zooming?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Native-resolution review hides text that collapses at delivery scale.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the encoded video at ordinary phone size and enlarge necessary labels.

questions.question: Do thin letter strokes survive the final encode rather than flicker or disappear?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Compression and rasterization erase fine typographic detail.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare source and encoded crops across several frames.

questions.question: Is the typeface's distinction between similar characters sufficient for the exact codes, numbers, or names shown?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ambiguous glyphs change the information a viewer reads.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the actual strings and replace the face or annotate ambiguous characters.

questions.question: Does text remain readable across the brightest and darkest parts of the moving background?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A single contrast check misses background changes under the text.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the complete text interval and add a stable backing where needed.

questions.question: Are line breaks preserving phrases that must be understood together?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Awkward wrapping splits negation, quantities, or modifier relationships.
questions.check_or_fix: Rewrap actual text manually at each delivery layout.

questions.question: Is the typographic hierarchy showing the main claim before its supporting detail?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Equal size and weight leave viewers without a reading order.
questions.check_or_fix: Reduce secondary emphasis and test the first item readers notice.

questions.question: Does the animation finish forming each word before the viewer needs to act on it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Letter-by-letter motion delays access to essential instruction.
questions.check_or_fix: Reveal urgent instructions as complete phrases and retime the action.

questions.question: Are number formatting and units unambiguous for the intended audience?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Locale conventions or missing units change the apparent magnitude.
questions.check_or_fix: Specify units and consistent separators in the exact on-screen values.

questions.question: Does justified or stretched text create word spacing that changes readability at short exposure times?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Artificial spacing breaks word recognition.
questions.check_or_fix: Use natural spacing and compare brief-exposure reading.

questions.question: Is text positioned inside the actual safe region after reframing and player overlays?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reframing or controls cover critical words.
questions.check_or_fix: Preview platform framing and move essentials into verified safe space.

questions.question: Do labels stay attached to the objects they describe during camera motion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Screen-space labels drift away from scene-space targets.
questions.check_or_fix: Track attachment points through the full move or use stable leader lines.

questions.question: Are leader lines terminating on distinct targets rather than crossing or pointing into empty space?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Annotation geometry creates incorrect object associations.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the crowded state and reroute ambiguous connectors.

questions.question: Does a kinetic word change its meaning through cropping or motion before the full phrase is available?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Moving fragments create an unintended statement.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect every intermediate readable fragment and revise the animation.

questions.question: Are minus signs, decimal points, superscripts, and exponents visible after scaling?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Small mathematical marks disappear while surrounding digits remain readable.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify each critical mark in the delivered encode at target size.

questions.question: Is a decorative display face being used for paragraphs that require sustained reading?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ornament impairs word recognition over longer passages.
questions.check_or_fix: Reserve the display face for short emphasis and simplify body type.

questions.question: Do font fallbacks preserve both meaning and layout when the project is reopened elsewhere?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Missing fonts change glyphs, wrapping, or timing.
questions.check_or_fix: Reopen in a clean environment and compare rendered text extents.

questions.question: Does animated emphasis land on the intended word without reversing the sentence's meaning?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Highlight timing stresses a qualifier or negation incorrectly.
questions.check_or_fix: Review the sentence with its actual emphasis sequence.

questions.question: Are quotation marks, attribution, and paraphrase styling clear enough to distinguish someone else's words from the narrator's?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Typography blurs quotation and authorial assertion.
questions.check_or_fix: Apply a consistent quotation treatment and verify exact attribution.

questions.question: Does the text remain crisp when transformed, or is a low-resolution raster layer being enlarged?
