questions.failure_hypothesis: Typography is scaled beyond its raster source resolution.
questions.check_or_fix: Render at final size or preserve vector text through compositing.

questions.question: Are right-to-left runs, mixed-direction numbers, or combined scripts displayed in the correct order?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Shaping or bidirectional handling rearranges meaning.
questions.check_or_fix: Have a fluent reader inspect the exact rendered strings.

questions.question: Do accented characters and non-Latin glyphs match the visual weight and baseline of surrounding text?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Partial font coverage produces conspicuous fallback glyphs.
questions.check_or_fix: Choose full-coverage fonts and inspect representative strings.

questions.question: Are automatically emphasized keywords actually important in context, including when they appear in negations or quotations?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Keyword matching highlights words whose local meaning should not receive emphasis.
questions.check_or_fix: Review every emphasis match in its complete sentence and correct semantic false positives.

questions.question: Is a title's visual treatment making a tentative claim look definitive?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Bold headline hierarchy suppresses uncertainty qualifiers.
questions.check_or_fix: Place the scope and qualifier within the same readable hierarchy.

questions.question: Does text cast or receive effects that reduce the counters and internal spaces needed for reading?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Glow, shadow, or extrusion closes letter shapes.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare effect-free and treated text at delivery size.

questions.question: Are tabular numbers aligned so viewers can compare place value rather than infer from uneven glyph widths?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Proportional spacing disguises numerical differences.
questions.check_or_fix: Use tabular figures or a clearly aligned layout.

questions.question: Does auto-fitting silently shrink the most important or longest message below the approved minimum?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fit-to-box logic prioritizes containment over readability.
questions.check_or_fix: Log fitted sizes and redesign outlier text instead of shrinking indefinitely.

questions.question: Are labels introduced with terminology that matches the narration and later references?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Synonyms look like separate concepts in a short film.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile the spoken and displayed term lists.

questions.question: Does perspective text become unreadable at oblique angles precisely when its information is needed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Scene-integrated typography sacrifices legibility to perspective.
questions.check_or_fix: Adjust the camera, text plane, or repeat essentials in a readable view.

questions.question: Is the visual reading order preserved when text is rearranged for a vertical version?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Responsive placement changes the intended argument sequence.
questions.check_or_fix: Read each format independently and revise its hierarchy.

questions.question: Does a legal or explanatory footnote contradict the prominent message while being too small to notice?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fine print is used to repair an overbroad headline.
questions.check_or_fix: Correct the main statement and make material limitations directly readable.

questions.question: Are important words ever partially hidden by decorative foreground elements during their reading interval?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Layer order allows ornament to occlude essential text.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect text visibility masks across the entire interval.

questions.question: Can the title be shortened without losing the specific promise, leaving more screen space for the actual evidence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Verbose wording consumes the image needed to support the claim.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a concise title alongside a larger evidence region.

questions.question: Do captions preserve every meaning-changing negation, name, and number in the actual spoken track?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Automated transcription drops small words that reverse meaning.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the final track against captions and correct consequential mismatches.

questions.question: Are caption boundaries aligned to complete thought groups rather than arbitrary word counts?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fragmented captions force viewers to reconstruct syntax under time pressure.
questions.check_or_fix: Re-segment by spoken phrasing and test an uninterrupted read-through.

questions.question: Can viewers identify an off-screen speaker when the voice alone is not available?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Untagged dialogue becomes unattributable with sound off.
questions.check_or_fix: Add concise speaker identifiers at ambiguous entrances.

questions.question: Are story-relevant sounds described when no visible action conveys them?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A silent viewer misses an unseen alarm, knock, or approach.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen for consequential sounds and add concise non-speech captions.

questions.question: Do captions reveal the answer or punchline before the corresponding performance delivers it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Early cue display spoils suspense or puzzle fairness.
questions.check_or_fix: Shift cue boundaries so essential reveal words arrive at their intended moment.

questions.question: Do captions cover faces, hands, demonstrations, or puzzle targets at any moment?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A fixed caption region obstructs essential visual evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Review full-length overlay playback and relocate captions at conflicts.

questions.question: Are captions still present and correctly timed after the final trim, speed change, or inserted slate?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Subtitle timestamps belong to an earlier edit.
questions.check_or_fix: Validate the caption track against the exact delivered file.

questions.question: Does the caption display duration allow the intended audience to read the longest cue comfortably?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Nominal caption presence conceals unreadably fast exposure.
questions.check_or_fix: Test long cues with target readers and split or extend them.

questions.question: Are overlapping voices represented without implying an order that was not spoken?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Captions serialize simultaneous speech into a false exchange.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to overlap passages and use clear multi-speaker formatting.

questions.question: Do automatic captions invent speech during silence, music, or unintelligible audio?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Recognition output hallucinates dialogue where none is recoverable.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to low-confidence sections and remove unsupported text.

questions.question: Can a viewer understand the essential argument with sound muted, including any instruction delivered only by voice?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Captions omit or summarize away necessary spoken reasoning.
questions.check_or_fix: Watch the actual muted delivery and attempt the stated viewer task.

questions.question: Is the audio description conveying crucial visual changes during gaps without competing with dialogue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Description either omits essential action or masks existing speech.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to a description mix with blind or low-vision reviewers when available.

questions.question: Do instructions rely on color alone, such as 'follow the red line,' without a second identifier?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Viewers cannot identify the referent without the intended color distinction.
questions.check_or_fix: Add position, pattern, or explicit labels to color-based references.

questions.question: Does rapid flashing or a strong alternating pattern require a qualified photosensitivity review before release?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Visually intense effects may pose a hazard missed by aesthetic review.
questions.check_or_fix: Run an appropriate flash analysis and review flagged intervals before approval.

questions.question: Can prolonged camera sway, rapid zooms, or full-field rotation be reduced without losing the explanation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unnecessary global motion creates avoidable discomfort.
questions.check_or_fix: Review motion-heavy intervals with sensitive viewers and test a calmer version.

questions.question: Are essential captions supplied as usable text tracks when the delivery context needs viewer control or search?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Burned-in text alone blocks selectable language or caption preferences.
questions.check_or_fix: Deliver verified sidecar or embedded tracks supported by the destination.

questions.question: Do translated captions preserve technical meaning rather than mirror source-language word order?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Literal translation distorts a key relation or instruction.
questions.check_or_fix: Have a fluent domain-capable reader review the actual rendered translation.

questions.question: Is the caption track labeled with the correct language and accessibility purpose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Incorrect metadata makes viewers choose an unsuitable track.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect track labels in the actual delivery player.

questions.question: Are meaningful changes in tone, such as sarcasm or whispering, recoverable when they affect the story?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Literal words conceal the intended social meaning.
questions.check_or_fix: Add restrained delivery cues only where the plot depends on them.

questions.question: Can viewers pause on a dense diagram without its labels or controls disappearing?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Essential information depends on transient UI or animated states.
questions.check_or_fix: Test pause and seek behavior at the densest explanatory frame.

questions.question: Are visual indications of success and failure distinguishable without an audio cue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Feedback meaning is available only through a chime or buzzer.
questions.check_or_fix: Add clearly different visual outcomes and test muted playback.

questions.question: Does narration describe a spatial relation precisely enough for a listener who cannot inspect the diagram?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Phrases such as 'over here' have no nonvisual referent.
questions.check_or_fix: Replace deictic wording with meaningful spatial or structural descriptions.

questions.question: Can viewers with less topic vocabulary follow the caption terminology without pausing for definitions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unexplained jargon creates an access barrier unrelated to the lesson.
questions.check_or_fix: Define necessary terms at first use and test with intended novices.

questions.question: Do caption italics, positioning, or color conventions remain understandable when the player ignores their styling?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Semantic distinctions depend on formatting the player may discard.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a plain-text fallback and add textual identifiers where necessary.

questions.question: Is a visible countdown accessible to someone relying on audio or captions without overwhelming the task?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Remaining response time is communicated in only one sensory channel.
questions.check_or_fix: Provide a restrained redundant time cue and test task completion.

questions.question: Are instructions given before an irreversible visual event rather than only while it is happening?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Slower readers receive the rule after the opportunity to use it.
questions.check_or_fix: Move the instruction earlier and separate it from execution.

questions.question: Does a picture-in-picture sign-language window remain large enough and unobstructed for its intended viewers?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The access layer is reduced or cropped until signing details are unreadable.
questions.check_or_fix: Review final-size playback with a qualified signer.

questions.question: Are lyrics that carry narrative information captioned distinctly from spoken dialogue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sung words disappear from access tracks or are mistaken for speech.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to relevant lyrics and include accurate, clearly identified cues.

questions.question: Does dense simultaneous motion, captioning, and sound make the central task harder for sensory-sensitive viewers?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Multiple salience peaks compete without a clear priority.
questions.check_or_fix: Remove nonessential stimulation and compare task performance.

questions.question: Are accessibility claims limited to checks actually performed on the delivered version?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A caption file is treated as proof of comprehensive accessibility.
questions.check_or_fix: List completed checks, reviewer scope, and untested needs explicitly.

questions.question: Does an emergency or safety instruction retain its full meaning across captions, narration, and visual symbols?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One access channel drops a condition that makes the advice safe.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile all channels against the verified instruction before release.

questions.question: Can a transcript substitute preserve references to important figures, sounds, and actions rather than just dialogue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A dialogue-only transcript loses the evidence used by the film.
questions.check_or_fix: Include concise descriptions at the relevant points and test independent reading.

questions.question: Does the melody leave enough rhythmic space for the spoken explanation to remain easy to follow?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Dense melodic activity competes with speech segmentation.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the full mix and simplify the melody during information-heavy passages.

questions.question: Is the harmonic change supporting the intended emotional turn rather than announcing a different mood?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Chord movement contradicts the character's visible change.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and compare an alternate harmonic treatment.

questions.question: Does a repeated motif become meaningful through its association with a character or idea?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A recurring tune has no stable narrative association.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across all appearances and define or remove its recurring role.

questions.question: Is the cue's musical climax arriving at the story's decisive event?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The strongest musical peak precedes or follows the real payoff.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen through the full arc and reshape the cue around the decisive beat.

questions.question: Does the opening establish an appropriate musical expectation for the kind of film that follows?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A grand or frantic intro promises an incompatible experience.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to opening and body consecutively with unbriefed viewers.

questions.question: Can the main rhythmic pulse still be understood when decorative percussion is removed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ornament conceals an unstable or unintelligible rhythmic foundation.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the stripped rhythm and rebuild accents around a clear pulse.

questions.question: Does the groove feel intentionally relaxed or driving rather than accidentally dragging against the performance?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Musical microtiming and visual performance imply incompatible energy.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with the performance and adjust swing or note placement.

questions.question: Are phrase lengths compatible with the film's editorial units without forcing unnatural cuts?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The arrangement requires cutting important scenes merely to reach a cadence.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to phrase boundaries and recompose or extend the cue instead.

questions.question: Does a looping cue preserve melodic and harmonic continuity at the actual loop join?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The loop returns to an unresolved or incompatible musical state.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen repeatedly across the join and rewrite the turnaround if needed.

questions.question: Does a long sustained harmony become fatiguing before the scene has completed its purpose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An unchanging bed creates tension or monotony unrelated to the content.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen for the full scene and introduce purposeful change or silence.

questions.question: Are bass movement and chord voicing reinforcing the intended tonal center?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Conflicting roots or voicings create unintended harmonic ambiguity.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to bass and harmony together and resolve accidental clashes.

questions.question: Is a dissonant accent purposeful and resolved in a way the audience can experience?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A stray note sounds like an error rather than expressive tension.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen in context and either develop or correct the dissonance.

questions.question: Does the instrumentation fit the depicted scale and intimacy of the scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Oversized orchestration overwhelms a small gesture or quiet explanation.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and test a reduced ensemble.

questions.question: Is musical variation adding a new emotional or structural function rather than merely changing instruments?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cosmetic arrangement swaps are mistaken for development.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across sections and name the changed musical purpose of each.

questions.question: Does the cue allow genuine silence where the story needs vulnerability, surprise, or attention?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Continuous scoring prevents meaningful contrast.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition selected unscored beats against the full cue.

questions.question: Are tension-building devices released after the conflict resolves?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Rising textures continue into the resolution and imply unresolved danger.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across the resolution and remove or transform lingering tension layers.

questions.question: Does the ending cadence sound intentional rather than like an arbitrary fade in the middle of a phrase?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Runtime trimming interrupts the composition's closure.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen without picture and write a coherent ending within the available time.

questions.question: Can a sparse cue sustain interest through articulation, dynamics, or timbre without adding unnecessary notes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Minimalism is implemented as inert repetition.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen for evolving detail and shape a restrained expressive arc.

questions.question: Do contrasting musical sections still belong to the same film's sound world?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unrelated patches or styles make transitions feel like stock-track swaps.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to cue boundaries and establish a shared motif or sonic palette.

questions.question: Does a comic sting strengthen the visible joke without explaining it before the audience discovers it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Musical punctuation telegraphs the joke too early.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with unbriefed viewers and move or simplify the sting.

questions.question: Are melodic leaps and sustained notes plausible for the instrument or voice being represented?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Generated writing exceeds the believable articulation or range.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with an instrument-aware reviewer and revise exposed implausible passages.

questions.question: Does the arrangement avoid having every instrument accent the same event at full intensity?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Uniform emphasis removes internal depth and creates musical clutter.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen by section and assign distinct foreground and support roles.

questions.question: Is rhythmic syncopation legible at the cue's actual tempo rather than only in the notation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fast off-beat detail becomes an indistinct flurry.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen at delivery speed and simplify patterns that lose their intended groove.

questions.question: Does tempo development follow a deliberate arc rather than drift because generated segments were joined?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Segment assembly produces unintended tempo changes.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across joins and compare measured beat intervals with the intended map.

questions.question: Are important melodic notes masked compositionally by competing lines in the same register?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Counterlines obscure the theme before mixing can establish hierarchy.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the arrangement and move or simplify competing registers.

questions.question: Does the music's cultural reference support the setting without relying on a shallow sonic stereotype?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Token instrumentation substitutes for researched musical context.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with informed reviewers and revise unsupported stylistic shorthand.

questions.question: Is an educational comparison using identical musical treatment where emotion should not bias the conclusion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One option sounds heroic and the other defective despite neutral evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen blind to each treatment and neutralize unintended evaluative cues.

questions.question: Does a purportedly cheerful cue contain an ominous undertone that changes the audience's reading of the scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Register, harmony, or texture communicates unintended threat.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with unbriefed viewers and revise the conflicting musical layer.

questions.question: Are dynamic changes shaped as musical phrases rather than constant global volume pumping?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Uniform automation substitutes for expressive articulation.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to phrases and adjust note-level or section-level dynamics.

questions.question: Can the cue survive removal of a fashionable sound without losing its identity?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The composition relies entirely on a transient production cliché.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to a neutral-instrument version and strengthen motif or structure.

questions.question: Does a generated cue repeat an obvious glitch or malformed phrase that the full arrangement initially distracts from?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Local generation artifacts recur beneath otherwise plausible music.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen closely to exposed and repeated passages and repair the affected phrase.

questions.question: What specific musical contribution is lost if this cue is replaced with silence during the key scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Music is present by habit without a defensible storytelling role.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to both versions and retain only a supported emotional or structural function.

questions.question: Can an unbriefed listener transcribe the sentence containing the film's main claim correctly?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Familiarity with the script masks unclear speech.
questions.check_or_fix: Play the final voice track to new listeners and compare their transcriptions.

questions.question: Is vocal stress placed on the word that carries the intended contrast?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Incorrect emphasis changes which alternative the sentence rejects.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen without reading the script and reperform ambiguous stress.

questions.question: Are proper names and specialist terms pronounced accurately for the subject and audience?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Synthetic or unfamiliar pronunciation undermines meaning and credibility.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with a knowledgeable speaker and correct the specific pronunciation.

questions.question: Do numbers, ranges, and units remain distinguishable when spoken at the final pace?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Similar-sounding quantities merge into an ambiguous instruction.
questions.check_or_fix: Have listeners write down the quantities and re-record errors.

questions.question: Does the narration sound as though it understands the sentence rather than reading punctuation mechanically?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Prosodic breaks interrupt the sentence's logical structure.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen phrase by phrase and revise punctuation or performance.

questions.question: Are breath pauses placed where a human speaker could plausibly breathe without splitting essential phrases?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Generated or edited speech has unnatural respiration and phrasing.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen through full sentences and restore plausible breath placement.

questions.question: Does the narrator's emotional intensity fit the evidence rather than oversell an ordinary result?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Excited delivery implies certainty or significance not supported by the film.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen blind to the claim and moderate unsupported enthusiasm.

questions.question: Can the audience distinguish recurring speakers without needing to look at the screen continuously?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Similar voices make the conversation hard to follow.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen audio-only and differentiate delivery or add clear attribution.

questions.question: Is the same character's voice consistent across separately generated or recorded lines?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Timbre, accent, or age changes imply a different speaker.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition adjacent and distant lines together and replace inconsistent takes.

questions.question: Does a change from narration to character speech sound intentional?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One delivery style blurs narrator and story-world dialogue.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to entrances and establish a distinct, consistent performance convention.

questions.question: Are plosive bursts obscuring the beginnings of important words?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Low-frequency microphone blasts mask consonants and distract.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen on full-range playback and repair or rerecord affected words.

questions.question: Does sibilance become piercing on actual listening even when meters show no clipping?
questions.failure_hypothesis: High-frequency consonant energy causes discomfort.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition on representative headphones and apply selective de-essing.

questions.question: Are mouth clicks or lip noises exposed in quiet passages enough to distract from the message?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Close-miked artifacts dominate a sparse soundtrack.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to quiet intervals and remove artifacts without damaging speech.

questions.question: Does noise reduction distort consonant edges or leave watery modulation around the voice?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Aggressive cleanup trades background noise for speech artifacts.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to original and processed takes and reduce processing where needed.

questions.question: Do edits between takes change room tone, vocal distance, or vocal effort within one sentence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Spliced speech sounds physically discontinuous.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across every splice and choose compatible takes or natural boundaries.

questions.question: Is a whispered or subdued line still understandable at the intended playback level?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Acting choice removes words essential to the plot.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen at ordinary volume and improve delivery or mix without changing intent.

questions.question: Does dialogue overlap communicate a motivated interruption rather than accidental timing congestion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Simultaneous lines obscure both intention and content.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with the scene and stagger or clarify the competing turns.

questions.question: Do the character's words and vocal emotion agree with the visible reaction at that moment?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Performance communicates an emotion the image does not support.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and reconcile the take with the reaction.

questions.question: Can listeners hear a meaning-changing negation clearly when it falls between louder words?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reduced articulation makes 'not' or equivalent disappear.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition the exact phrase with new listeners and strengthen the negation.

questions.question: Are acronyms expanded, spoken, or spelled consistently with how the intended audience recognizes them?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The voice invents an unfamiliar reading of a technical abbreviation.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with domain users and standardize the acronym treatment.

questions.question: Does switching languages preserve a credible pronunciation and speaking rhythm in each language?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Multilingual delivery distorts one language while sounding fluent in another.
questions.check_or_fix: Obtain fluent listening review for every language segment.

questions.question: Is an accent being performed intelligibly without caricature or arbitrary inconsistency?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Exaggerated accent cues distract or stereotype the character.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with informed speakers and revise unsupported performance choices.

questions.question: Do pauses around a quote make its beginning and end audible without visual punctuation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Listeners misattribute quoted words to the narrator.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen audio-only and add natural attribution or clear vocal framing.

questions.question: Does removing filler words accidentally make a hesitant or uncertain speaker sound more confident than they were?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cleanup changes the meaning of an authentic statement.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to source and edited context and preserve consequential hesitation.

questions.question: Is speech sped up enough to sound strained or erase the narrator's natural cadence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Duration fitting sacrifices intelligibility and believable delivery.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen at final speed and shorten the script instead of overcompressing speech.

questions.question: Does the narrator address the intended audience with an appropriate level of familiarity and authority?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Delivery assumes expertise, age, or intimacy the audience does not share.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with representative viewers and adjust register rather than only vocabulary.

questions.question: Are sentence endings audible rather than trailing below the noise floor or music bed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Important qualifiers are lost in fading vocal energy.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to endings in the full mix and repair delivery or automation.

questions.question: Does the dialogue give each character a distinct objective instead of making every line explain the plot?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Exposition replaces interaction and weakens performance.
questions.check_or_fix: Read aloud and listen for lines no character would need to say.

questions.question: Does the voice's apparent microphone perspective remain compatible with a supposedly continuous scene?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Dry close speech abruptly becomes distant without a scene change.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen consecutively and align recording or processing perspective.

questions.question: Are generated breaths, laughs, or emotional interjections convincing in their immediate context?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Synthetic nonverbal sounds break character believability.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and replace or remove implausible interjections.

questions.question: Does a long narration segment develop vocal energy naturally instead of resetting to the same opening cadence each sentence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sentence-by-sentence generation produces a repetitive presentation pattern.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the complete paragraph and reperform it as a coherent thought.

questions.question: Is there any spoken instruction or claim in the delivered voice that is absent from the approved script?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ad-libs or generation artifacts introduce unreviewed content.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen end to end while reconciling the delivered transcript to the script.

questions.question: Does the delivered mix contain audible distortion at impacts or other peaks despite an unclipped project meter?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Encoding or intersample peaks distort the exported waveform.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure the final file and actually listen to its loudest events.

questions.question: Is dialogue intelligible under the busiest music and effects passage at ordinary listening volume?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Masking peaks hide speech despite acceptable overall loudness.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the complete mix and rebalance the busiest interval.

questions.question: Does dialogue ducking recover naturally after speech rather than making the music audibly surge between words?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Overfast gain recovery causes distracting pumping.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across short speech gaps and revise ducking timing.

questions.question: Does the mix retain essential sounds when summed to mono?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Phase cancellation removes cues on single-speaker playback.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition a mono downmix and repair phase-dependent elements.

questions.question: Are low-frequency effects crowding out clarity or wasting headroom without an audible storytelling benefit?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sub-bass accumulation drives limiting while contributing little useful sound.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen full-range and on phone speakers, then trim unsupported low end.

questions.question: Does the soundtrack remain balanced on the actual phone or laptop speakers likely to be used?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A studio-only mix depends on bass and detail small speakers cannot reproduce.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen on representative devices and rebalance essential cues.

questions.question: Are important off-screen sounds too far to one stereo side to be heard reliably with one earbud?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hard panning makes a narrative cue fragile in common listening conditions.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition each channel alone and reposition or reinforce essential cues.

questions.question: Does ambience continue naturally through cuts within the same place and time?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Room or environmental tone resets expose edits and break continuity.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen without picture across cuts and smooth justified ambience transitions.

questions.question: Do noise gates audibly chop breaths, room tone, or sustained sound tails?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Threshold processing creates abrupt silence and damaged decay.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to soft endings and ease gating or use manual cleanup.

questions.question: Is reverberation appropriate to the apparent room size and source distance?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Acoustic space contradicts the visual environment.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and adjust early reflections and decay contextually.

questions.question: Are footsteps, touches, and object movements giving the represented material and weight a plausible sound?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Generic effects make soft, heavy, or hollow objects sound alike.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and replace mismatched material cues.

questions.question: Does a major impact have a distinct onset and decay rather than becoming an undifferentiated wall of effects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Layer stacking removes the event's audible shape.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition effect layers separately and restore a clear attack/body/tail structure.

questions.question: Are repeated effects varying in a way that avoids machine-like repetition while preserving the event's identity?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Identical samples reveal the production pattern.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the entire repeated sequence and vary suitable takes or articulation.

questions.question: Does a sound continue after its source has visibly stopped for a physically or narratively justified reason?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Untrimmed effects imply motion or activity no longer present.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and align source cessation and credible decay.

questions.question: Are quiet atmospheric details audible enough to support the scene without making viewers raise volume dangerously before loud events?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Excessive dynamic range creates an impractical listening experience.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen at one fixed normal level and rebalance essential quiet and loud passages.

questions.question: Does compression preserve the punch of intentional transients rather than flatten every action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Heavy limiting removes contrast and makes impacts feel weak.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to level-matched processed and unprocessed versions.

questions.question: Is there a harsh resonant frequency that becomes tiring over the full runtime?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Narrowband buildup is tolerable briefly but fatiguing across the film.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen continuously and reduce the identified resonance selectively.

questions.question: Do looped ambience beds have audible seams or repeated identifiable events?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A background loop reveals itself through a recurring chirp, click, or level jump.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across multiple loops and edit or vary the bed.

questions.question: Are source distance changes accompanied by believable changes in level, detail, and room contribution?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A moving source sounds fixed next to the listener.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with the movement and automate acoustic perspective deliberately.

questions.question: Does the mix make a decorative sound more prominent than the story's causal sound?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Salient ornament distracts from the event viewers must understand.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen without picture to identify the perceived foreground, then rebalance.

questions.question: Are left and right channels mapped correctly for directional cues?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A routing swap contradicts on-screen movement.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to a known directional sequence in the delivered file.

questions.question: Does a surround or multichannel mix downmix without losing center dialogue or overemphasizing effects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unverified downmix rules alter the intended hierarchy.
questions.check_or_fix: Audition destination downmixes and correct channel assignment or levels.

questions.question: Are accidental clicks introduced at edits, fades, or sample boundaries?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Discontinuous waveforms create transient artifacts.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to edit boundaries closely and repair fades or zero crossings.

questions.question: Does hiss, hum, or electrical buzz emerge during sparse sections where it was previously masked?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Background contamination becomes audible when the arrangement thins.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to quiet full-mix passages and remove the specific contamination.

questions.question: Is an effect being used to imply a real mechanism the image does not demonstrate?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sound supplies false evidence of contact, locking, charging, or completion.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and verify the physical event behind each causal cue.

questions.question: Does an abrupt loud sound startle the audience beyond what the scene or audience context warrants?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unmotivated level contrast creates avoidable distress or discomfort.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen at ordinary volume and soften or prepare the cue where appropriate.

questions.question: Is the soundtrack's loudness being judged on the final encode rather than solely on a premaster?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Later encoding, normalization, or replacement changes the delivered balance.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure and listen to the exact delivered version.

questions.question: Do effect layers occupy complementary spectral regions instead of multiplying the same muddy band?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Layering increases density without adding perceptual detail.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to isolated and combined layers and remove redundant material.

questions.question: Are intentional periods of silence clean and shaped, rather than revealing sudden residual noise or truncated tails?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mute automation creates conspicuous technical gaps.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen through silence entries and exits and shape the transitions.

questions.question: Can listeners tell when a sound belongs to the scene versus a nonliteral editorial accent?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sound design confuses real-world events with commentary.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and establish a consistent sonic distinction.

questions.question: Does the final audio contain unintended preview tags, spoken watermarks, or test tones?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Temporary or uncleared production audio survives into delivery.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen end to end and reconcile every audible element to the final asset list.

questions.question: Does normalizing a short clip hide a problematic internal jump between adjacent scenes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Whole-file loudness compliance masks local imbalance.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across every scene boundary and adjust local balance.

questions.question: Do visible lip closures coincide with the corresponding consonants in the delivered dialogue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mouth animation uses a nearby but perceptually wrong phoneme timing.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and inspect exposed consonants frame by frame.

questions.question: Does a footstep sound land on weight-bearing contact rather than on the foot's lowest airborne position?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Naive motion markers misidentify the actual contact event.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with the walk and align cues to verified contact frames.

questions.question: Are musical accents aligned to the perceptually important phase of a gesture rather than merely its keyframe timestamp?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Technical alignment misses the gesture's experienced peak.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen at normal speed and compare anticipation, peak, and settle placements.

questions.question: Does synchronization drift progressively from the beginning to the end of the video?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Audio and picture were interpreted under different clock or rate assumptions.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare early and late landmarks and listen through the delivered file.

questions.question: Is a constant global audio offset shifting every sound ahead of or behind the picture?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Container or timeline offset moves the entire soundtrack.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure several independent landmarks and verify the correction by listening.

questions.question: When narration says 'this part,' is the intended object already visible and still highlighted?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Spoken reference and visual focus occupy different intervals.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and align each deictic phrase to its referent.

questions.question: Does a spoken explanation introduce a diagram feature before the feature changes beyond recognition?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The image advances while the voice still describes its prior state.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with the animation and hold the referenced state through the phrase.

questions.question: Are deliberate anticipatory sounds clearly nonliteral rather than suggesting an impact before contact?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An editorial whoosh is mistaken for a physically early collision.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and distinguish anticipation from the contact cue.

questions.question: Does an echo or repeated effect make one visible event seem like two separate actions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Audible repetitions imply extra events absent from the picture.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen without prior context and simplify ambiguous repeats.

questions.question: Does the audiovisual loop return to the same phase in both music and movement?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unequal loop lengths cause a new phase mismatch on each repeat.
questions.check_or_fix: Play multiple loops and compare shared start landmarks.

questions.question: Does speed-ramping footage preserve the intended relationship between source motion and sound duration?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Picture retiming leaves effects or dialogue at incompatible speeds.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across ramps and retime or replace sound intentionally.

questions.question: Are sharp audio transients still aligned after video frame-rate conversion quantizes the event time?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Conforming rounds visual events but leaves sample-accurate audio unchanged.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect converted landmarks and listen to the final cadence.

questions.question: Does encoder priming or inserted silence delay the first audible event relative to the first visual action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Codec padding alters the beginning of the delivered clip.
questions.check_or_fix: Decode and listen from the start in target players.

questions.question: Is the last spoken word or sound decay audible before the encoded picture ends?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mismatched stream durations truncate the soundtrack's conclusion.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen through the actual endpoint and inspect both stream durations.

questions.question: Do separately rendered scene segments share one timeline rather than restarting local audio phase at each join?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Segment assembly resets a continuous cue or ambience cycle.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen across all joins and compare segment offsets to the master timeline.

questions.question: Does apparent source motion across the screen agree with audible spatial movement?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Pan automation follows the wrong trajectory or direction.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with headphones and picture, then align spatial cues to the intended path.

questions.question: Is any intended sound-travel delay plausible and distinguishable from accidental desynchronization?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Delayed sound appears broken because distance or scale is not established.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with the shot and verify the delay rationale and visual distance cue.

questions.question: Does a countdown's audible pulse indicate the same remaining time as its visible numerals?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Timer graphics and audio clicks are driven by separate clocks.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen while stepping through numeral changes and reconcile the time authority.

questions.question: Are sound cues for simultaneous comparison panels using the same event definition on both sides?
questions.failure_hypothesis: One panel sounds at anticipation while the other sounds at completion.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to isolated panels and normalize the cue criterion.

questions.question: Does an audio-reactive graphic actually derive from the delivered audio rather than a different draft?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A plausible waveform or meter displays unrelated signal data.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare audio features to graphic timing and listen at mismatched peaks.

questions.question: Does automatic beat detection identify the pulse listeners actually hear in this cue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An estimator locks onto subdivisions or half-time accents.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen and tap the pulse, then compare it with detected beats.

questions.question: Are repeated visual accents distributed musically when the beat period is not an integer number of video frames?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Naive rounding accumulates jitter or duplicates accent frames.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect frame scheduling and listen to the long repeated sequence.

questions.question: Does a frozen image accompanied by continuing action sounds imply an event the viewer can no longer verify?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Audio continuation creates false off-screen progress during a freeze.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with picture and either justify the off-screen action or change the cue.

questions.question: Does reversing a shot leave sound envelopes that suggest forward action or an impossible sequence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reversed visuals retain incompatible attack and decay cues.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the reversed sequence and redesign sound for the intended event.

questions.question: Are emotional vocal pauses coordinated with visible reactions instead of overwritten by unrelated movement?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The body advances while the voice is still processing the moment.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with performance and retime reaction beats around the spoken thought.

questions.question: Does a visual beat tied to spoken wording still work in a translated or alternate-voice version?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Different phrase lengths break an alignment inherited from the original.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to every language version with its actual picture timing.

questions.question: Is the audio track paired with the exact picture revision it was mixed against?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A correctly timed soundtrack is attached to a different cut.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify version hashes and listen at each changed edit boundary.

questions.question: Does seeking or resuming playback introduce an audiovisual offset that continuous playback does not reveal?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Player buffering or timestamps cause transient desynchronization after navigation.
questions.check_or_fix: Test real seek/resume behavior and listen at recognizable sync events.

questions.question: Are scene ambience changes synchronized with the intended acoustic boundary rather than arbitrary cut points?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sound changes rooms before the character crosses the doorway.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with spatial action and place the acoustic transition at the justified moment.

questions.question: Does a note or effect trigger twice when a visual event sits on a segment or loop boundary?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Inclusive boundary logic schedules the same event in both adjacent blocks.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit event IDs and listen across the affected boundary.

questions.question: Can the apparent synchronization be verified on the actual destination rather than inferred from an editor preview?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Preview playback compensation hides delivery-specific timing problems.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen and watch the uploaded or delivered rendition on its real player.

questions.question: If a cue is deliberately off-beat, does that mismatch read as expressive timing rather than an error?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Intentional displacement is too weakly motivated to be perceived as design.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen with unbriefed viewers and compare an aligned version.

questions.question: Can every imported asset be traced to the exact source file and license that applied when it was obtained?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A generic website reference is substituted for asset-specific permission.
questions.check_or_fix: Build a file-hash ledger linked to retained license evidence.

questions.question: Does the license permit the intended rendered use, including commercial or promotional distribution if planned?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A broadly labeled free asset has narrower use restrictions.
questions.check_or_fix: Review the exact license against the declared distribution purpose.

questions.question: May the original asset be included in editable project delivery, rather than only in a finished render?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Native-source packaging redistributes material beyond render-only permission.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate source-redistribution rights from rendered-output rights.

questions.question: Are music composition rights and sound-recording rights both resolved for the exact cue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Permission for one rights layer is mistaken for permission for both.
questions.check_or_fix: Identify the composition and recording owners and retain applicable grants.

questions.question: Do sampled sounds within a music track have provenance independent of the finished track's author claim?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A composer supplies music containing uncleared third-party samples.
questions.check_or_fix: Request the sample inventory and evidence covering the intended use.

questions.question: Does a voice performance have permission for this use, including synthetic replication if that occurred?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Recording permission is stretched into unauthorized voice cloning or reuse.
questions.check_or_fix: Check the performer grant against the actual generation and distribution method.

questions.question: Are recognizable people's likenesses used within the scope they authorized?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Footage or images are repurposed beyond the original consent.
questions.check_or_fix: Match the planned context and audience to the relevant release.

questions.question: If a minor appears, is the permission record appropriate to that person's age and planned distribution?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ordinary asset handling overlooks heightened consent requirements.
questions.check_or_fix: Hold uncertain use for qualified review and verify the relevant authorization.

questions.question: Do visible trademarks or branded interfaces falsely suggest sponsorship, affiliation, or endorsement?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Context converts incidental branding into an implied commercial relationship.
questions.check_or_fix: Review framing and wording and remove unsupported endorsement cues.

questions.question: Is a stock asset restricted to editorial use while the film serves a promotional purpose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A convenient stock download is used in an incompatible context.
questions.check_or_fix: Check the exact asset's license designation and replace if necessary.

questions.question: Are required credits present, accurate, and readable in the actual delivered package?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Attribution obligations are lost between working notes and export.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare each required credit with the final video and accompanying files.

questions.question: Does cropping or editing an asset remove a notice or violate a restriction on modification?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Production changes strip required attribution or exceed permitted alterations.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the modified asset to its retained terms.

questions.question: Are font licenses sufficient for the render, embedded file, and editable source being delivered?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Desktop font use is mistaken for unrestricted font redistribution.
questions.check_or_fix: Check each font's permitted output and embedding modes separately.

questions.question: Can a generated asset's model and service terms support the specific output use being claimed?
questions.failure_hypothesis: 'AI-generated' is treated as automatic unrestricted ownership.
questions.check_or_fix: Record the actual model/service version and applicable output terms.

questions.question: Is any claim that training data or model outputs are fully rights-cleared supported by evidence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An unsupported assurance is repeated as a legal guarantee.
questions.check_or_fix: Limit claims to documented rights and disclose unresolved provenance.

questions.question: Does a model or tool require a particular paid tier or organizational license for this use?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A technically available route exceeds the license actually held.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify the installed tool's entitlement against the planned production.

questions.question: Are third-party plugins, scripts, or model weights being bundled only where redistribution is permitted?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A reproducibility package inadvertently redistributes restricted dependencies.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit package contents and replace restricted binaries with acquisition instructions.

questions.question: Have license expiration, project limits, or download-credit conditions been checked for this particular deliverable?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Permission assumed from an old subscription does not cover the present use.
questions.check_or_fix: Retain the applicable grant and verify its project and time scope.

questions.question: Are territory, platform, or audience restrictions compatible with every planned destination?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A cleared local use is silently expanded into a broader release.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare each destination against the recorded permission scope.

questions.question: Does a derivative or adapted asset carry conditions that must survive into the combined work?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Adaptation obligations are lost during compositing or conversion.
questions.check_or_fix: Identify derivative-use conditions and review the assembled delivery.

questions.question: Are the licenses of combined reusable assets compatible with how the project will be shared?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Separate permissive-looking grants impose conflicting redistribution conditions.
questions.check_or_fix: Review the intended combined package before committing to its license.

questions.question: Can a reference-inspired design be distinguished from copying protected character, shot, or sequence expression?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Surface changes disguise close reproduction of a specific work.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare expressive choices and redesign similarities that lack a cleared basis.

questions.question: Does a photographed location contain artwork or other protected material that needs separate consideration?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Location permission is mistaken for rights to every depicted work.
questions.check_or_fix: Inventory prominent embedded works and resolve uncertain uses.

questions.question: Is permission to film on a property being confused with permission to promote or commercially associate with it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A location release has a narrower purpose than the final presentation.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the final context with the actual property agreement.

questions.question: Have preview assets, watermarked downloads, and evaluation-only files been excluded from the final package?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Temporary production material is mistaken for licensed final content.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit every final asset hash against the cleared inventory.

questions.question: Are original creators and collaborators credited according to the actual agreement rather than inferred from filenames?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Informal naming obscures authorship or contractual credit.
questions.check_or_fix: Confirm contribution records and agreed credit wording.

questions.question: Does an asset's claimed public-domain status apply in the relevant jurisdiction and to this exact version?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A modern restoration, translation, or recording is conflated with an older work.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify the specific version and obtain qualified review where uncertain.

questions.question: Are screenshots of private systems free of information the user did not authorize sharing?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Demonstration footage exposes personal or confidential content incidentally.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect full-resolution frames and mask or replace unauthorized information.

questions.question: Is a synthetic or staged performance labeled honestly where its origin affects the viewer's interpretation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Generated footage is presented as authentic capture or testimony.
questions.check_or_fix: Document production origin and add an appropriate clear disclosure.

questions.question: If the same cleared asset is reused in another episode, does the permission cover that additional project?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Single-project rights are silently treated as a reusable-library license.
questions.check_or_fix: Check project-count and reuse terms before reuse.

questions.question: Can reviewers distinguish creator-owned material from licensed material and unresolved material in the handoff?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Mixed provenance is flattened into a blanket ownership statement.
questions.check_or_fix: Assign explicit provenance status to every deliverable component.

questions.question: Is the final rights signoff tied to the delivered asset versions rather than earlier approved substitutes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Late asset swaps bypass the rights review.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile final hashes and changes against the approved rights ledger.

questions.question: Can each factual sentence be matched to a source that supports its exact scope rather than merely the general topic?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Broad source relevance is mistaken for support of a specific claim.
questions.check_or_fix: Build a claim-to-source ledger with exact supporting passages.

questions.question: Are time-sensitive facts still valid at the date the video will be delivered?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A formerly accurate script becomes misleading through age.
questions.check_or_fix: Recheck unstable claims against current authoritative sources before release.

questions.question: Does a historical claim match the exact locality, period, and object depicted?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A generally plausible prop is used as evidence for an overly specific claim.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify the depicted variant and narrow unsupported specificity.

questions.question: Are measurements and labels using consistent units and conversion assumptions throughout the film?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Numerically plausible values mix incompatible units.
questions.check_or_fix: Independently recompute conversions and audit visible and spoken units.

questions.question: Does a percentage state its denominator and comparison baseline clearly enough to reproduce it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A favorable percentage hides a changed denominator or base period.
questions.check_or_fix: Show the relevant counts and recompute the displayed percentage.

questions.question: Are averages concealing variation that materially changes the lesson?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A central value is presented as typical despite a wide or skewed distribution.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the distribution and add a relevant range or counterexample.

questions.question: Does the edit distinguish correlation from a demonstrated causal mechanism?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Associated events are narrated as cause and effect.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit causal wording against the study or demonstration design.

questions.question: Is a counterfactual comparison supported by a valid method rather than an invented alternate outcome?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The film fabricates what would have happened without the intervention.
questions.check_or_fix: State the method and assumptions or replace it with a verified worked case.

questions.question: Are uncertainty and limitations visible at the point where the audience forms the conclusion?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Caveats arrive too late to constrain an authoritative impression.
questions.check_or_fix: Place material uncertainty beside the claim and test interpretation.

questions.question: Are a diagram's idealizations clearly distinguished from measured or physically exact behavior?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Clean animation is mistaken for observational evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Label the model assumptions and identify where realism is intentionally omitted.

questions.question: Does a conserved quantity remain consistent across every displayed step when the lesson depends on conservation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Attractive animation creates or destroys the quantity it claims to track.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile a stepwise ledger with every relevant frame state.

questions.question: Are interpolation and extrapolation visually distinguishable from actual observed data?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Smooth curves imply measurements or predictions beyond the evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Mark observed points and clearly identify modeled extensions.

questions.question: Does the graph's axis choice preserve the comparison the narration claims?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Truncation or nonlinear scaling exaggerates the apparent effect.
questions.check_or_fix: Replot with disclosed alternatives and review the claimed interpretation.

questions.question: Is any simulated motion being described as a validated physical result without a suitable model check?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Visual plausibility is treated as evidence of physical accuracy.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate illustrative animation from validated simulation claims.

questions.question: Does a mathematically correct example rely on assumptions absent from the on-screen problem?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The calculation solves a different problem than the viewer is given.
questions.check_or_fix: List assumptions and reconcile them with the stated setup.

questions.question: Do all displayed algorithm outputs come from the exact algorithm version being described?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Explanatory graphics show hand-edited or stale results.
questions.check_or_fix: Regenerate outputs from the pinned implementation and compare them.

questions.question: Has the algorithm been checked on boundary inputs rather than only the attractive demonstration case?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Empty, singleton, extreme, or invalid inputs expose unmentioned failure behavior.
questions.check_or_fix: Define the valid domain and test its meaningful boundaries.

questions.question: Are tie-breaking and ordering rules explicit when they can change the visible result?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An apparently unique answer depends on an unstated arbitrary order.
questions.check_or_fix: Declare the rule and test tied or permuted inputs.

questions.question: Can numerical rounding or tolerance choices flip a displayed classification or comparison?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Near-boundary values produce unstable or misleading decisions.
questions.check_or_fix: Test values around thresholds and expose relevant tolerance rules.

questions.question: Does random generation enforce the promised constraints for every output rather than merely most seeds?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A successful sample is treated as proof of a universal invariant.
questions.check_or_fix: Test and validate each generated instance against the explicit constraints.

questions.question: Is the chosen demonstration seed representative rather than selected to hide common failures?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Cherry-picked outputs exaggerate reliability or quality.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect a declared sample set and report failures alongside the selected case.

questions.question: Does the on-screen algorithm explanation account for failure or nontermination conditions that matter in use?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A happy-path animation conceals an unsafe or unusable edge behavior.
questions.check_or_fix: Identify relevant failure states and demonstrate or disclose them.

questions.question: Are test results described only as evidence for the specific assertions the tests actually evaluate?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unit-test success is inflated into factual or production approval.
questions.check_or_fix: Map every success claim to test scope and untested dimensions.

questions.question: Are proposed capabilities clearly separated from capabilities demonstrated by a retained output?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Plans and documentation are reported as completed functionality.
questions.check_or_fix: Require a concrete artifact and check record for each demonstrated claim.

questions.question: Are counts of recipes, styles, stories, and tested videos using distinct definitions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Combinatorial variants are presented as independent authored or tested works.
questions.check_or_fix: Publish separate counts with explicit counting units.

questions.question: Does a performance claim include the actual environment, input size, and end-to-end work measured?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Selective timing omits setup, review, retries, or costly stages.
questions.check_or_fix: Record the complete measured workflow under stated conditions.

questions.question: Is a cost-saving claim based on actual charges and a comparable baseline?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Estimates or omitted cloud costs are presented as demonstrated savings.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile invoices and measured effort with the comparison workflow.

questions.question: Are safety-critical instructions blocked from authoritative presentation until appropriate current sources resolve them?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Plausible but unchecked advice could cause real harm.
questions.check_or_fix: Obtain suitable current primary-source review and hold unresolved instructions.

questions.question: Do conflicting reliable sources remain visible as an unresolved issue rather than being silently averaged into a claim?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Source disagreement is hidden behind false certainty.
questions.check_or_fix: Record the conflict, scope, and dates and narrow the claim if possible.

questions.question: Does the final voice, caption, and graphic all state the same corrected fact after a script revision?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A correction updates one channel while stale variants survive elsewhere.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile all delivered channels against the corrected claim ledger.

questions.question: Is a reconstructed, generated, or illustrative scene clearly distinguished from documentary evidence?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Synthetic imagery appears to prove an event or observation.
questions.check_or_fix: Label the representation and cite the actual evidence separately.

questions.question: Does the claim of interactivity correspond to actual user-controllable behavior rather than a prerecorded question?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A passive video is marketed as interactive software.
questions.check_or_fix: Demonstrate the claimed input-response path or describe the work accurately.

questions.question: Does the final render contain every intended frame exactly once and in the correct order?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Batch rendering omits, duplicates, or misorders frames.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the frame sequence against the expected index manifest.

questions.question: Are nominally adjacent render chunks evaluating animation at the same shared time authority?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Local chunk clocks create motion jumps at boundaries.
questions.check_or_fix: Render boundary overlaps and compare identical-time frames.

questions.question: Is the export using final-resolution assets rather than proxies or preview caches?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Low-resolution working material survives a successful render.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit resolved asset paths and inspect final-scale texture/detail crops.

questions.question: Do the output dimensions and pixel aspect ratio produce the intended display geometry?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Correct pixel counts still yield stretched or squeezed playback.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect sample/display aspect metadata and compare a known geometric reference.

questions.question: Is the chosen crop preserving every required subject and label throughout the full camera move?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Static framing checks miss content lost at movement extremes.
questions.check_or_fix: Scan the delivered frame bounds against protected regions over time.

questions.question: Does the color-management path apply the display transform exactly once?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Missing or doubled transforms alter contrast and color.
questions.check_or_fix: Trace source, working, and output transforms and compare reference patches.

questions.question: Are HDR sources and SDR output being mapped without losing important highlight or shadow information?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Automatic tone mapping hides detail or changes intended hierarchy.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect controlled reference scenes through the actual output transform.

questions.question: Do saturated colors survive output conversion without clipping away distinctions needed for the task?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Gamut conversion merges separate color categories.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare important color regions before and after export conversion.

questions.question: Does limited bit depth introduce visible banding in gradients that were smooth in the working render?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Quantization creates contour steps after export.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect final encoded gradients at ordinary and stressed viewing conditions.

questions.question: Are transparent edges composited with the correct premultiplied or straight-alpha interpretation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Alpha mismatch creates dark or bright halos around cutouts.
questions.check_or_fix: Composite edge tests over light and dark backgrounds.

questions.question: Does motion blur erase a puzzle target, contact event, or technical detail needed to verify the action?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A cinematic shutter setting destroys required evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Review the decisive frames and lower blur selectively where needed.

questions.question: Are temporal denoising or upscaling leaving ghost trails around moving silhouettes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: History-based processing blends incompatible object positions.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect moving edges across consecutive final frames.

questions.question: Does the sample count support stable shadows and reflections rather than flickering noise?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Undersampling turns static surface appearance into distracting temporal variation.
questions.check_or_fix: Render a short motion test at candidate settings and compare stability.

questions.question: Are fine patterns and linework stable under motion after rasterization?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Spatial detail exceeds the sampling rate and produces shimmer or moire.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect full-speed output and adjust filtering or detail frequency.

questions.question: Does frame interpolation invent malformed intermediate geometry or duplicate a decisive event?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Synthetic in-between frames distort the action.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect interpolated intervals around occlusions and contact.

questions.question: Are cached simulations and rendered layers from the same approved scene revision?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Stale caches combine old motion with new geometry or timing.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile cache hashes and invalidate mismatched dependencies.

questions.question: Are all required render passes actually included in the final composite?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A successful beauty export omits masks, shadows, or corrective passes.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the pass manifest to the compositing graph and final image.

questions.question: Does the export accidentally include guides, bounding boxes, debug text, or temporary watermarks?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Review overlays remain enabled in the delivery render.
questions.check_or_fix: Scan the full encoded file for nonfinal layers and markers.

questions.question: Are procedural expressions and animated effects evaluated correctly by the final renderer rather than only the editor?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The export path silently drops unsupported runtime behavior.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare representative editor and final-render frames at effect extremes.

questions.question: Does final depth of field keep necessary labels, clues, and causal contacts identifiable?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Preview sharpness differs from the final camera's focus treatment.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect final focus at each required observation interval.

questions.question: Is the export frame rate the approved rate rather than a default inherited from another project?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A preset silently changes duration or motion cadence.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify nominal and actual frame timestamps against the project contract.

questions.question: Does the render range include the intended final resolved pose without appending an accidental blank or repeated frame?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Inclusive/exclusive endpoint confusion damages the ending.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare requested frame range with decoded first and last frames.

questions.question: Are color-range flags consistent with the actual encoded signal levels?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Full/limited-range mismatch produces washed-out or crushed output.
questions.check_or_fix: Decode with verified interpretation and inspect reference levels.

questions.question: Is the pixel format supported by the intended playback route while retaining required visual detail?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A technically valid export is unsuitable for destination decoding or chroma detail.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the exact format in destination players and inspect critical edges.

questions.question: Do subtitles, graphics, and audio belong to the same language and revision in a batch export?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reused batch variables combine incompatible version components.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify each package against its language/revision manifest.
