questions.question: Does the final duration satisfy the requested range without padded silence or black frames?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A duration target is met by filler instead of a coherent edit.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure runtime and review the opening and closing content intervals.

questions.question: Can high-compression output still preserve the smallest essential target and distinction?
questions.failure_hypothesis: File-size optimization defeats the video's core viewing task.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare candidate encodes at intended viewing size using the actual task.

questions.question: Does export metadata accidentally mark the file as rotated, stereoscopic, or panoramic when it is ordinary flat video?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Inherited metadata causes unintended player transformations.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect relevant flags and verify plain playback geometry.

questions.question: Is the encoded file truly generated from the reviewed source rather than an older render with a new filename?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Renaming conceals stale content while appearing current.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify source/render hashes and compare changed landmarks.

questions.question: Are separate render jobs contaminating one another through shared temporary files or output paths?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Concurrent jobs overwrite assets or frames silently.
questions.check_or_fix: Use isolated job directories and reconcile per-job output hashes.

questions.question: Does an interrupted export leave a partial file that could be mistaken for a complete deliverable?
questions.failure_hypothesis: File existence is treated as render success.
questions.check_or_fix: Require successful completion plus full decode and duration validation.

questions.question: Are final-render quality claims supported by viewing the whole encoded result rather than selected attractive stills?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Still-frame inspection misses motion, transition, and temporal defects.
questions.check_or_fix: Watch the full delivered encode and record timecoded findings.

questions.question: Does the delivered filename's extension agree with the actual media container and streams?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A renamed file is mistaken for a valid export in the promised format.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect file signatures and stream metadata rather than trusting the name.

questions.question: Are the downloaded bytes identical to the approved deliverable when no destination transcoding is intended?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Transfer or packaging corruption changes the approved file.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare cryptographic hashes before and after the real download path.

questions.question: Can the complete delivered file be decoded without errors, including its final frames?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Header inspection misses corruption late in the media stream.
questions.check_or_fix: Run a full decode and review every reported error.

questions.question: Does the exact codec profile and level play on the lowest supported device?
questions.failure_hypothesis: General codec support is mistaken for support of every profile and resolution.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the delivered file on the stated minimum device/player.

questions.question: Is hardware acceleration required for smooth playback on the intended audience's devices?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A demanding encode stutters on realistic decoding hardware.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure dropped frames and responsiveness on representative devices.

questions.question: Can progressive playback begin promptly without downloading the entire file first?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Container layout delays access to essential playback metadata.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a fresh download over the expected connection and inspect startup behavior.

questions.question: Does the video remain useful under the destination's lowest likely adaptive rendition?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Automatic quality reduction erases critical text or puzzle details.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the actual low-bitrate rendition using the viewer's task.

questions.question: Does constrained bandwidth cause stalls precisely during the solving or decision interval?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Buffer interruptions alter the intended experience and available response time.
questions.check_or_fix: Test realistic constrained playback and provide a suitable download option if needed.

questions.question: Are rotation and display-orientation flags interpreted consistently by target players?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Different players rotate or letterbox the same pixels differently.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the file on the supported player set.

questions.question: Does the selected thumbnail reveal a puzzle answer or narrative surprise before playback?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Automatically chosen preview imagery spoils the experience.
questions.check_or_fix: Review the actual destination thumbnail and select an appropriate authorized replacement.

questions.question: Is the intended audio track selected by default rather than commentary, a stem, or another language?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Track ordering or metadata causes the wrong listening experience.
questions.check_or_fix: Open the final file fresh in target players and listen to the default track.

questions.question: Does muted autoplay still make the opening intelligible enough for the viewer to choose whether to continue?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The initial experience depends on audio the platform suppresses.
questions.check_or_fix: Test actual muted autoplay and make the opening promise visible.

questions.question: Are caption sidecars actually linked and available to the recipient rather than merely sitting beside the source file?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Captions exist in storage but are absent from the delivery player.
questions.check_or_fix: Open the recipient-facing player and enable the supplied captions.

questions.question: Does switching language tracks select a matching caption track where the player supports that behavior?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Independent track defaults produce mismatched spoken and written languages.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the available language combinations explicitly.

questions.question: Has destination transcoding finished before the video is described as ready for review?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A placeholder or incomplete low-quality rendition is mistaken for final delivery.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify processing completion and inspect the resulting rendition.

questions.question: Does playback reach the intended ending rather than stop early at a bad duration or timestamp boundary?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Container timing makes a valid tail inaccessible to the player.
questions.check_or_fix: Play through the end and compare visible duration with decoded content.

questions.question: Can a viewer seek to a critical explanation without waiting excessively or landing on corrupted frames?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Sparse or malformed random-access points impair navigation.
questions.check_or_fix: Seek repeatedly around key sections on target players.

questions.question: Does loop playback include an unintended pause, black flash, or duplicate frame imposed by the destination player?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Local seamlessness is broken by destination loop behavior.
questions.check_or_fix: Observe multiple actual destination loops and adjust delivery if possible.

questions.question: Do player controls or captions supplied by the destination cover evidence placed near the frame edge?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Delivery UI obscures content that was safe in the clean export.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect the real player with controls and captions visible.

questions.question: Does automatic platform cropping preserve the intended composition in every supported presentation slot?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Feed, preview, or full-screen modes use different crops.
questions.check_or_fix: Test each actual slot and prepare separately reviewed variants where needed.

questions.question: Are the file's access settings limited to the audience the user authorized?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Delivery convenience accidentally makes a private film publicly reachable.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect sharing scope before sending and verify the intended recipient view.

questions.question: Can the intended recipient open the delivered attachment or link with their actual permissions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Owner access is mistaken for recipient access.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify recipient access without broadening permissions beyond authorization.

questions.question: Will the access link remain valid for the expected review period?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An expiring transfer fails before reviewers can use it.
questions.check_or_fix: Check expiry against the agreed review window and choose a suitable authorized route.

questions.question: Does destination caching continue serving an older rendition after the approved file has been replaced?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A cached media response defeats an otherwise correct version update.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare fresh-session playback and downloaded rendition identity with the approved replacement.

questions.question: Does the media metadata expose unintended location, personal names, internal paths, or production notes?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hidden metadata leaks information absent from the visible film.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit metadata and remove unnecessary private fields from the delivery copy.

questions.question: Is a compatibility fallback the same approved revision as the primary file?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A playable alternate silently delivers an older story or fact.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare version manifests and content landmarks across all variants.

questions.question: Is the playable film clearly separated from source archives so the recipient does not have to unpack a project to watch it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Packaging makes a technically complete delivery unusable for its audience.
questions.check_or_fix: Provide a clearly identified playback file alongside any approved source package.

questions.question: Are the delivery instructions naming a genuinely available file rather than a private build path?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The handoff points to storage the recipient cannot reach.
questions.check_or_fix: Follow every recipient-facing link or attachment path from the recipient context.

questions.question: Does an embedded player require third-party cookies or an account that the intended audience may not have?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Authentication or browser privacy constraints block otherwise valid media.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the expected signed-out or restricted-browser context.

questions.question: Does the destination recompress audio in a way that introduces artifacts or changes speech intelligibility?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Source audio review does not cover the platform's actual rendition.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to the processed destination audio on representative devices.

questions.question: Are review comments attached to an immutable version so later replacement cannot change what was approved?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A moving link makes prior feedback and signoff ambiguous.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve version IDs or hashes in the review record.

questions.question: Can a recipient tell which file is the final intended version when several drafts or aspect ratios are present?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Ambiguous naming leads to review or distribution of the wrong asset.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a clear manifest identifying status, purpose, and approved version.

questions.question: What concrete thing should the intended viewer understand, feel, or be able to do after this video?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A vague audience goal prevents meaningful evaluation of success.
questions.check_or_fix: Write one observable viewer outcome before judging the cut.

questions.question: Can first-time viewers state the video's central point without being told the creator's intention?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Production familiarity is mistaken for communicated meaning.
questions.check_or_fix: Collect unprompted summaries after a single complete viewing.

questions.question: Does the film assume background knowledge its intended audience actually lacks?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unstated prerequisites make the explanation inaccessible to novices.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the premise with representative novices and introduce necessary prerequisites.

questions.question: Is there enough specific value for an experienced viewer, or only an elaborate statement of the obvious?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Visual polish disguises a trivial takeaway.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask informed viewers what new useful distinction they gained.

questions.question: Does the opening promise accurately describe the value the rest of the film delivers?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A compelling hook attracts viewers to a different or weaker result.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare the hook with the actual demonstrated takeaway.

questions.question: Can viewers apply the lesson to a new example rather than merely repeat the shown answer?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Recognition is mistaken for transferable understanding.
questions.check_or_fix: Present a different appropriate case after viewing.

questions.question: Do viewers remember the essential point after a short delay without replaying the film?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Immediate fluency masks fragile retention.
questions.check_or_fix: Use a delayed recall check matched to the intended use.

questions.question: Does the video save a user measurable effort compared with the manual workflow it claims to improve?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Claimed convenience ignores setup, corrections, and review effort.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare complete workflows on the same realistic task.

questions.question: Is the benefit still present when the user must correct the output's common errors?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A fast first result creates more downstream repair work.
questions.check_or_fix: Include observed repair effort in the usefulness comparison.

questions.question: Can viewers identify what remains uncertain or unproven after watching?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Persuasive presentation creates confidence beyond the evidence.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask viewers which claims were demonstrated and which remain open.

questions.question: Does the piece respect the viewing situation, such as interruption, background noise, or a small screen?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A design that works in a quiet review room fails in normal use.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the actual intended context and prioritize its essential information.

questions.question: Would a viewer choose to watch the full runtime for the value delivered, without being obliged to review it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Creator interest is mistaken for audience attention.
questions.check_or_fix: Observe voluntary stopping points and ask what value remained unclear.

questions.question: Does the film provide a reason to care before requesting effortful interpretation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Audience labor is demanded before a relevant benefit is established.
questions.check_or_fix: Introduce a concrete stake or practical question early.

questions.question: Are emotional reactions based on the story rather than pressure from manipulative framing or exaggerated claims?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Presentation extracts a response without earning trust.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask viewers what specifically caused their reaction and check supporting content.

questions.question: Does the film's novelty come from a useful idea or experience rather than only a different visual skin?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Surface variation is counted as additional audience value.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare takeaways and experiences across related films without style labels.

questions.question: Can a viewer distinguish the intended subject from decorative spectacle when asked what mattered?
questions.failure_hypothesis: High production density competes with the actual point.
questions.check_or_fix: Collect salience rankings and reduce low-value dominant elements.

questions.question: Does the video make a difficult concept easier to reason about than a simpler static explanation would?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Motion adds complexity without explanatory benefit.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare comprehension using the video and a concise static alternative.

questions.question: Is the format appropriate to the viewer's task, such as learning a process versus checking a reference fact?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A linear film is used for information viewers need to scan or revisit.
questions.check_or_fix: Observe task behavior and add a suitable companion reference if warranted.

questions.question: Does the conclusion leave the viewer with a feasible next step when action is the purpose?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The film motivates action without explaining what can actually be done.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask viewers to name their next step and remove practical ambiguity.

questions.question: Are effort, tools, prerequisites, and costs disclosed when viewers are encouraged to replicate a result?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A polished demonstration hides barriers that affect usefulness.
questions.check_or_fix: Itemize the actual replication requirements beside the demonstrated outcome.

questions.question: Can viewers recognize the limits of the example instead of generalizing it to unsuitable situations?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A memorable example becomes an overbroad rule.
questions.check_or_fix: Test a boundary case and make the relevant limitation explicit.

questions.question: Does humor rely on cultural knowledge the intended audience is likely to share?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The setup is invisible to viewers outside the creator's reference group.
questions.check_or_fix: Test the joke with relevant audience groups and revise missing context.

questions.question: Are potentially alienating depictions necessary to the film's purpose and understood as intended?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unexamined stereotypes distract or harm trust.
questions.check_or_fix: Seek relevant perspective and revise unsupported representational shortcuts.

questions.question: Does the film reward attention with a satisfying resolution rather than an engagement bait that never pays off?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A question or promise exists only to prolong viewing.
questions.check_or_fix: Identify the delivered payoff and test whether viewers feel the promise was met.

questions.question: Do actual audience findings remain separate from synthetic reviewer suggestions in the report?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Generated opinions are presented as human research.
questions.check_or_fix: Label the origin of every review and report human sample details honestly.

questions.question: Is the audience sample relevant to the intended users rather than only the production team?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Familiar or expert reviewers miss novice misunderstandings.
questions.check_or_fix: Document participant relevance and recruit appropriate review when authorized.

questions.question: Does the evaluation question measure the intended outcome instead of asking only whether viewers liked the video?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Satisfaction is mistaken for comprehension, accuracy, or usefulness.
questions.check_or_fix: Match the question and task to the stated success criterion.

questions.question: Are observed improvements large enough to matter in the viewer's real task?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A measurable change is framed as valuable despite negligible practical effect.
questions.check_or_fix: Define a task-relevant benefit threshold and compare actual outcomes.

questions.question: Does a polished before-and-after comparison hold task difficulty and input quality constant?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Unfair conditions exaggerate the apparent value of the approach.
questions.check_or_fix: Match inputs and conditions and disclose unavoidable differences.

questions.question: Is the viewer asked to do more work than the payoff justifies, such as reading dense setup for a minor joke?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Participation cost exceeds the value of the experience.
questions.check_or_fix: Observe effort and confusion, then simplify setup or strengthen payoff.

questions.question: Can skeptical viewers locate the evidence behind the video's strongest claim?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Credibility depends on production authority rather than inspectable support.
questions.check_or_fix: Provide a clear evidence route appropriate to the delivery format.

questions.question: Does repeating the viewing reveal useful detail or merely expose the lack of a clear first-view explanation?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Required replay is mislabeled as replay value.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask what prompted replay and distinguish enrichment from repair.

questions.question: Does the stated rule define exactly what counts as a target, including partial, stylized, or obscured examples?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Solvers apply different reasonable category boundaries.
questions.check_or_fix: Write explicit inclusion criteria and test ambiguous instances.

questions.question: Can every counted target be identified at ordinary viewing size in the actual delivery encode?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Technical degradation makes nominally present targets practically unknowable.
questions.check_or_fix: Test all targets at destination size without zooming.

questions.question: Are target-like decorations excluded, removed, or clearly distinguishable from valid targets?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Incidental shapes create an equally reasonable alternate count.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit the whole image for unmanifested target-like forms.

questions.question: Do reflections, shadows, pictures-within-pictures, or repeated displays have a stated counting rule?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Representation layers are confused with additional physical targets.
questions.check_or_fix: Declare the rule before solving and apply it consistently.

questions.question: Is the answer unique under every interpretation allowed by the written rules?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The puzzle has multiple valid solutions despite a single-answer reveal.
questions.check_or_fix: Enumerate or independently reason through admissible solutions.

questions.question: Does the reveal use the same scene and rules the solver actually saw?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The answer is justified by altered evidence or a revised definition.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare puzzle and reveal states before adding annotations.

questions.question: Can the answer be proven from visible evidence without relying on hidden object IDs or creator knowledge?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Internal scene metadata supplies information unavailable to viewers.
questions.check_or_fix: Ask an independent solver to justify the answer from the delivered video alone.

questions.question: Are targets that leave the frame counted consistently with the declared observation window?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A moving-camera puzzle silently changes whether off-screen objects count.
questions.check_or_fix: Define the window and whether counting is instantaneous or cumulative.

questions.question: Can solvers track a target through motion without counting it again when it reappears?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Identity loss through cuts or occlusion inflates cumulative counts.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve distinctive identity or redesign motion to avoid ambiguous reentry.

questions.question: Does each valid target receive enough unobscured exposure to be found within the promised solving time?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Brief technical visibility is mistaken for a fair observation opportunity.
questions.check_or_fix: Measure clear exposure and verify detection with new solvers.

questions.question: Are the hardest targets difficult because of intended reasoning or search, rather than blur, compression, or unreadable size?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The challenge depends on production defects rather than puzzle design.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare clean and delivered versions and remove degradation-dependent difficulty.

questions.question: Does an occluded target expose enough diagnostic features to justify its classification?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Solvers must guess what is behind a foreground object.
questions.check_or_fix: Identify the visible evidence for membership or increase fair exposure.

questions.question: Are similarly drawn species or categories distinguishable under the puzzle's actual target definition?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Stylization erases the trait needed to separate valid and invalid objects.
questions.check_or_fix: Test category recognition independently of the counting task.

questions.question: Does a size-ordering puzzle specify whether solvers should compare apparent image size or implied real-world size?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Perspective creates two reasonable size rankings under an unstated metric.
questions.check_or_fix: State the comparison metric and verify the answer using that metric.

questions.question: Does the puzzle require outside knowledge that the premise presents as a purely visual search?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hidden trivia changes the task without warning.
questions.check_or_fix: State the knowledge requirement or supply the needed information.

questions.question: Does the wording leak the intended answer when the task is meant to require discovery?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A title, count label, or grammatical cue gives away the solution.
questions.check_or_fix: Read all visible text before viewing the puzzle and check for answer leakage.

questions.question: Do relational clues still identify the intended objects after mirroring or reframing for another layout?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Left-right or relative-position clues become false in a transformed version.
questions.check_or_fix: Solve each delivered layout independently and revise directional clues where needed.

questions.question: Is an impossible instance allowed by the prompt, or does the wording guarantee a solution that may not exist?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Contradictory constraints force solvers to search indefinitely for a nonexistent answer.
questions.check_or_fix: Check satisfiability and state explicitly when 'no solution' is an admissible response.

questions.question: Can pausing or replaying change the challenge in a way that should be acknowledged in the instructions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A timed challenge implies control over playback it does not possess.
questions.check_or_fix: Describe the intended play convention without claiming enforced interactivity.

questions.question: Are optional hints ordered so each helps without accidentally giving away the entire solution?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The first hint collapses the task while later hints add nothing.
questions.check_or_fix: Test hint-by-hint solving and revise the information progression.

questions.question: Does the answer reveal identify every counted target exactly once?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Highlighting omits, duplicates, or skips targets while displaying a plausible total.
questions.check_or_fix: Reconcile reveal IDs and visible markers with the count manifest.

questions.question: Do reveal outlines remain registered to moving targets under the final camera transform?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Annotations point at empty space or neighboring distractors.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect marker-to-target alignment across the full reveal.

questions.question: Is the clean solving view free from faint reveal masks, numbering, or residual answer overlays?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hidden or partially transparent solution layers leak assistance.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect exported solving frames with the intended contrast and brightness.

questions.question: Can a target enter or leave the valid set during animation without an explicit rule for that state change?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Morphing, opening, or orientation changes make the answer time-dependent.
questions.check_or_fix: Freeze membership or define when and how it changes.

questions.question: Does random layout generation preserve solution uniqueness and fair spacing for this specific instance?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Generic generator constraints fail on the selected arrangement.
questions.check_or_fix: Validate the delivered instance and independently solve it.

questions.question: Are distractors wrong for a visible reason rather than an arbitrary creator-only exception?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The answer depends on an unstated special case.
questions.check_or_fix: Require an observable exclusion reason for each close distractor.

questions.question: Does a visual pattern have a defensible next step rather than several equally simple continuations?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A preferred pattern is presented as mathematically compelled.
questions.check_or_fix: Compare alternative rules and narrow the prompt where necessary.

questions.question: Are number puzzles robust to rounding, operation-order, and notation conventions used by the audience?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Different standard conventions yield different answers.
questions.check_or_fix: State conventions and independently solve the displayed notation.

questions.question: If an audio clue is essential, is that requirement clear before muted viewers begin solving?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A seemingly visual puzzle quietly depends on unheard information.
questions.check_or_fix: Listen to identify essential audio clues and label the required modality.

questions.question: Are example solutions consistent with the actual rules rather than teaching an exception that never returns?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The tutorial primes a strategy the main puzzle rejects.
questions.check_or_fix: Apply every example's reasoning to the final instance.

questions.question: Does the difficulty claim reflect actual cold solving rather than the creator's familiarity with the answer?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Insider knowledge distorts both estimated difficulty and allotted time.
questions.check_or_fix: Test with unbriefed relevant solvers and report the limited sample honestly.

questions.question: Does the reveal explain why plausible alternative answers fail, rather than merely displaying the preferred number?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A declarative answer leaves legitimate ambiguity unresolved.
questions.check_or_fix: Address the strongest alternate interpretation with visible evidence.

questions.question: Can another authorized machine open the native project without relying on the creator's private absolute paths?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hidden local paths make the handoff nonportable.
questions.check_or_fix: Reopen from a clean location and repair unresolved relative dependencies.

questions.question: Are all required source assets present at the exact versions used for the approved render?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Similar filenames conceal missing or changed source bytes.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify a complete asset manifest against cryptographic hashes.

questions.question: Is the actual renderer, application, plugin, and model version recorded rather than only a generic tool name?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Environment drift prevents reproducing the approved appearance.
questions.check_or_fix: Capture the versions used by the successful build.

questions.question: Does the project declare which dependencies are installed separately because they cannot be bundled?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A supposedly self-contained package omits essential external components.
questions.check_or_fix: Separate included assets from required external dependencies and acquisition steps.

questions.question: Can the render be reproduced using the documented command without undocumented manual editor state?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Hidden UI settings or selection state determine the output.
questions.check_or_fix: Rebuild from a fresh session following only the handoff.

questions.question: Are random seeds and generation inputs retained wherever stochastic output affects the film?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Re-running changes placement, motion, or generated assets unpredictably.
questions.check_or_fix: Save seeds, exact inputs, and generated source bytes.

questions.question: Does the workflow distinguish reproducible procedural assets from generation steps that cannot be rerun identically?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A prompt is treated as sufficient to recreate nondeterministic output.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve exact generated files and state the repeatability boundary.

questions.question: Are scene units, coordinate conventions, and frame-rate assumptions explicit in the handoff?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reopening or importing changes scale, orientation, or time interpretation.
questions.check_or_fix: Record conventions and verify a known reference object and event.

questions.question: Is there one authoritative timeline and scene transform for camera, targets, masks, and audio?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Parallel timing or transform systems drift when the scene changes.
questions.check_or_fix: Map shared authorities and test a controlled timing/camera edit.

questions.question: Can a maintainer change one character or prop without breaking unrelated layers or hidden references?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Tight coupling turns a local edit into widespread damage.
questions.check_or_fix: Perform a bounded substitution in a copy and inspect dependent outputs.

questions.question: Do layer names and ownership describe real independently controllable roles rather than arbitrary duplicates?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Inflated layer counts conceal an unmaintainable monolithic composition.
questions.check_or_fix: Audit each layer's purpose and demonstrate meaningful isolation.

questions.question: Are the clean puzzle, reveal annotations, captions, and audio separable for future revisions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Flattened deliverables force destructive edits for routine updates.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify editable source separation for the promised revision types.

questions.question: Does changing a source asset invalidate all caches that depend on it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A render appears updated while stale cached geometry or frames persist.
questions.check_or_fix: Alter a controlled fixture and trace cache invalidation through the pipeline.

questions.question: Are generated intermediates distinguishable from authoritative source files?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A maintainer edits disposable output and loses changes on regeneration.
questions.check_or_fix: Label source-of-truth files and document regeneration boundaries.

questions.question: Can a failed long render resume without silently skipping or mixing frames from another revision?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Resume logic treats stale partial output as valid progress.
questions.check_or_fix: Test interruption and restart with per-frame provenance checks.

questions.question: Does the build fail clearly when an asset, font, or plugin is missing instead of silently substituting it?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Fallback behavior produces plausible but incorrect output.
questions.check_or_fix: Remove a controlled dependency in a test copy and inspect the failure mode.

questions.question: Are configuration defaults safe when a new episode omits a required field?
questions.failure_hypothesis: An inherited default silently supplies the wrong story, count, or export setting.
questions.check_or_fix: Validate required fields and test intentionally incomplete inputs.

questions.question: Are output filenames and directories derived from stable project/version identifiers rather than mutable titles alone?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Renaming or duplicate titles overwrite unrelated work.
questions.check_or_fix: Test collision cases and include stable IDs in the build manifest.

questions.question: Can automated checks detect a deliberately wrong target count, missing frame, or stale caption file?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Green test reports prove only that the test runner executed.
questions.check_or_fix: Seed representative known-wrong fixtures and verify expected failures.

questions.question: Can a maintainer recover why the current creative choice was selected over the rejected alternatives?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Missing decision history causes discarded approaches to be repeated as new improvements.
questions.check_or_fix: Retain representative alternatives with dated, evidence-linked selection reasons.

questions.question: Are visual regression comparisons tolerant of harmless variation but sensitive to meaningful defects?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Pixel diffs either flood reviewers with noise or miss semantic failures.
questions.check_or_fix: Calibrate against accepted variations and known consequential defects.

questions.question: Is there a small representative fixture for each risky renderer, codec, or plugin upgrade?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Upgrades are tested only by rerendering the entire film after failure.
questions.check_or_fix: Preserve minimal scenes covering contact, text, transparency, sound, and timing risks.

questions.question: Can the previous approved version be restored after an unsuccessful edit or dependency upgrade?
questions.failure_hypothesis: The workflow overwrites the only working source and output.
questions.check_or_fix: Verify versioned backups and perform a bounded restore test.

questions.question: Are external URLs or cloud services required at render time documented with an offline fallback where feasible?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Network changes make a previously working local project fail.
questions.check_or_fix: Test dependency availability and preserve authorized local inputs.

questions.question: Does the package avoid including credentials, session tokens, or machine-specific secrets?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Reproducibility packaging leaks authentication material.
questions.check_or_fix: Inspect configuration and archives for secrets without exposing their values.

questions.question: Are expected runtime, memory, storage, and temporary-file requirements recorded from an actual run?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Another machine cannot reproduce the output within available resources.
questions.check_or_fix: Capture resource use and distinguish measurements from estimates.

questions.question: Does automated cleanup preserve authoritative sources and only remove declared disposable outputs?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Broad deletion patterns destroy irreplaceable project material.
questions.check_or_fix: Review cleanup scope and test it against a protected fixture tree.

questions.question: Can a maintainer trace a delivered frame or sound back to its source revision and responsible edit?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Final output provenance is lost across transformations.
questions.check_or_fix: Retain build manifests linking outputs, source commits, and asset versions.

questions.question: Are known defects and untested routes documented so a future maintainer does not repeat disproven assumptions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: A clean handoff conceals unresolved problems and failed approaches.
questions.check_or_fix: Record reproducible defects and distinguish untested alternatives from working routes.

questions.question: Does a format round trip preserve the specific hierarchy, animation, or editability promised to the recipient?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Export/import success is mistaken for preservation of native behavior.
questions.check_or_fix: Round-trip a representative source and compare promised features explicitly.

questions.question: Are factual, rights, and dependency records linked to the assets they must be rechecked against when those assets change?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Maintenance updates bypass the reviews invalidated by the change.
questions.check_or_fix: Define review triggers from the dependency graph and test one controlled replacement.

questions.question: Can a new maintainer complete one realistic revision using only the package and its instructions?
questions.failure_hypothesis: Documentation looks complete but omits practical steps needed to work.
questions.check_or_fix: Run a bounded handoff exercise and repair observed gaps.
